        document.getElementById(
            "adminDashboard"
        );


    const loginForm =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminLoginForm"
        );


    const emailInput =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminEmail"
        );


    const passwordInput =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminPassword"
        );


    const loginButton =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminLoginButton"
        );


    const loginAlert =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminLoginAlert"
        );


    const headerActions =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminHeaderActions"
        );


    const logoutButton =
        document.getElementById(
            "logoutButton"
        );


    const totalApplications =
        document.getElementById(
            "totalApplications"
        );


    const submittedApplications =
        document.getElementById(
            "submittedApplications"
        );


    const approvedApplications =
        document.getElementById(
            "approvedApplications"
        );


    const rejectedApplications =
        document.getElementById(
            "rejectedApplications"
        );


    const refreshApplications =
        document.getElementById(
            "refreshApplications"
        );


    const adminLoading =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminLoading"
        );


    const adminEmpty =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminEmpty"
        );


    const adminTableWrapper =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminTableWrapper"
        );


    const applicationsTableBody =
        document.getElementById(
            "applicationsTableBody"
        );


    const adminMessage =
        document.getElementById(
            "adminMessage"
        );


    function showLoginAlert(
        message,
        type
    ) {

        loginAlert.textContent =
            message;

        loginAlert.className =
            "admin-alert show " +
            (type || "error");

    }


    function clearLoginAlert() {

        loginAlert.textContent =
            "";

        loginAlert.className =
            "admin-alert";

    }


    function showMessage(
        message,
        type
    ) {

        adminMessage.textContent =
            message;

        adminMessage.className =
            "admin-message show " +
            (type || "error");

    }


    function clearMessage() {

        adminMessage.textContent =
            "";

        adminMessage.className =
            "admin-message";

    }


    function getToken() {

        return localStorage.getItem(
            "rationPortalToken"
        );

    }


    function getStoredUser() {

        try {

            const raw =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalUser"
                );

            return raw
                ? JSON.parse(raw)
                : null;

        }
        catch (error) {

            return null;

        }

    }


    function storeAuthentication(
        token,
        user
    ) {

        localStorage.setItem(
            "rationPortalToken",
            token
        );


        localStorage.setItem(
            "rationPortalUser",
            JSON.stringify(user)
        );

    }


    function clearAuthentication() {

        localStorage.removeItem(
            "rationPortalToken"
        );

        localStorage.removeItem(
            "rationPortalUser"
        );

    }


    function isAdminUser(
        user
    ) {

        if (!user) {
            return false;
        }

        return String(
            user.role || ""
        ).toUpperCase() === "ADMIN";

    }


    function showDashboard() {

        loginSection.style.display =
            "none";

        dashboard.classList.add(
            "show"
        );

        headerActions.style.display =
            "flex";

        loadApplications();

    }


    function showLogin() {

        loginSection.style.display =
            "flex";

        dashboard.classList.remove(
            "show"
        );

        headerActions.style.display =
            "none";

    }


    function normalizeApplications(
        data
    ) {

        if (Array.isArray(data)) {
            return data;
        }

        if (
            data &&
            Array.isArray(data.data)
        ) {
            return data.data;
        }

        if (
            data &&
            Array.isArray(data.content)
        ) {
            return data.content;
        }

        return [];

    }


    function statusClass(
        status
    ) {

        const normalized =
            String(
                status || ""
            )
                .trim()
                .toLowerCase();

        return "status-" +
            normalized;

    }


    function escapeHtml(
        value
    ) {

        if (
            value === null ||
            value === undefined
        ) {

            return "";

        }

        return String(value)
            .replaceAll("&", "&amp;")
            .replaceAll("<", "&lt;")
            .replaceAll(">", "&gt;")
            .replaceAll('"', "&quot;")
            .replaceAll("'", "&#039;");

    }


    function renderStatistics(
        applications
    ) {

        totalApplications.textContent =
            applications.length;


        submittedApplications.textContent =
            applications.filter(
                function (application) {

                    return String(
                        application.status || ""
                    ).toUpperCase() ===
                        "SUBMITTED";

                }
            ).length;


        approvedApplications.textContent =
            applications.filter(
                function (application) {

                    return String(
                        application.status || ""
                    ).toUpperCase() ===
                        "APPROVED";

                }
            ).length;


        rejectedApplications.textContent =
            applications.filter(
                function (application) {

                    return String(
                        application.status || ""
                    ).toUpperCase() ===
                        "REJECTED";

                }
            ).length;

    }


    function renderApplications(
        applications
    ) {

        applicationsTableBody.innerHTML =
            "";


        if (
            !applications ||
            applications.length === 0
        ) {

            adminTableWrapper.style.display =
                "none";

            adminEmpty.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

            return;

        }


        adminEmpty.classList.remove(
            "show"
        );


        applications.forEach(
            function (application) {

                const row =
                    document.createElement(
                        "tr"
                    );


                const currentStatus =
                    String(
                        application.status ||
                        "SUBMITTED"
                    )
                        .trim()
                        .toUpperCase();


                const safeApplicationNumber =
                    escapeHtml(
                        application.applicationNumber
                    );


                row.innerHTML = `

                    <td>
                        <span class="application-number">
                            ${safeApplicationNumber}
                        </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHtml(
                            application.applicantName ||
                            "â€”"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHtml(
                            application.email ||
                            "â€”"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHtml(
                            application.mobile ||
                            "â€”"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHtml(
                            application.cardType ||
                            "â€”"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        ${escapeHtml(
                            application.district ||
                            "â€”"
                        )}
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <span class="status-badge ${statusClass(currentStatus)}">
                            ${escapeHtml(currentStatus)}
                        </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>

                        <select
                            class="status-select"
                            data-application-number="${safeApplicationNumber}"
                        >

                            <option
                                value="SUBMITTED"
                                ${currentStatus === "SUBMITTED" ? "selected" : ""}
                            >
                                SUBMITTED
                            </option>

                            <option
                                value="PENDING"
                                ${currentStatus === "PENDING" ? "selected" : ""}
                            >
                                PENDING
                            </option>

                            <option
                                value="VERIFIED"
                                ${currentStatus === "VERIFIED" ? "selected" : ""}
                            >
                                VERIFIED
                            </option>

                            <option
                                value="APPROVED"
                                ${currentStatus === "APPROVED" ? "selected" : ""}
                            >
                                APPROVED
                            </option>

                            <option
                                value="REJECTED"
                                ${currentStatus === "REJECTED" ? "selected" : ""}
                            >
                                REJECTED
                            </option>

                        </select>

                        <br>

                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="status-update-button"
                            data-application-number="${safeApplicationNumber}"
                        >
                            Update
                        </button>

                    </td>

                `;


                const updateButton =
                    row.querySelector(
                        ".status-update-button"
                    );


                updateButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        const applicationNumber =
                            this.getAttribute(
                                "data-application-number"
                            );


                        const select =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".status-select"
                            );


                        updateApplicationStatus(
                            applicationNumber,
                            select.value,
                            this
                        );

                    }
                );


                applicationsTableBody.appendChild(
                    row
                );

            }
        );


        adminTableWrapper.style.display =
            "block";

    }


    async function loadApplications() {

        const token =
            getToken();


        if (!token) {

            clearAuthentication();

            showLogin();

            return;

        }


        adminLoading.style.display =
            "block";

        adminTableWrapper.style.display =
            "none";

        adminEmpty.classList.remove(
            "show"
        );

        clearMessage();


        try {

            const response =
                await fetch(
                    API_BASE +
                    "/applications",
                    {
                        method: "GET",
                        headers: {
                            "Authorization":
                                "Bearer " +
                                token,
                            "Accept":
                                "application/json"
                        }
                    }
                );


            if (
                response.status === 401 ||
                response.status === 403
            ) {

                clearAuthentication();

                showLogin();

                showLoginAlert(
                    response.status === 403
                        ? "Administrator access is required."
                        : "Your session has expired. Please sign in again.",
                    "error"
                );

                return;

            }


            let data = null;


            try {

                data =
                    await response.json();

            }
            catch (error) {

                data = null;

            }


            if (!response.ok) {

                throw new Error(
                    data &&
                    (
                        data.message ||
                        data.error
                    )
                        ? (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                        : "Unable to load applications."
                );

            }


            const applications =
                normalizeApplications(
                    data
                );


            renderStatistics(
                applications
            );


            renderApplications(
                applications
            );

        }
        catch (error) {

            console.error(
                "Admin application loading error:",
                error
            );


            showMessage(
                error.message ||
                "Unable to load applications.",
                "error"
            );

        }
        finally {

            adminLoading.style.display =
                "none";

        }

    }


    async function updateApplicationStatus(
        applicationNumber,
        status,
        button
    ) {

        const token =
            getToken();


        if (!token) {

            clearAuthentication();

            showLogin();

            return;

        }


        const originalText =
            button.textContent;


        button.disabled =
            true;

        button.textContent =
            "Updating...";


        clearMessage();


        try {

            const response =
                await fetch(
                    API_BASE +
                    "/applications/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        applicationNumber
                    ) +
                    "/status",
                    {
                        method: "PUT",
                        headers: {
                            "Authorization":
                                "Bearer " +
                                token,
                            "Content-Type":
                                "application/json",
                            "Accept":
                                "application/json"
                        },
                        body:
                            JSON.stringify({
                                status:
                                    status
                            })
                    }
                );


            let data = null;


            try {

                data =
                    await response.json();

            }
            catch (error) {

                data = null;

            }


            if (
                response.status === 401 ||
                response.status === 403
            ) {

                clearAuthentication();

                showLogin();

                showLoginAlert(
                    "Administrator access is required.",
                    "error"
                );

                return;

            }


            if (!response.ok) {

                throw new Error(
                    data &&
                    (
                        data.message ||
                        data.error
                    )
                        ? (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                        : "Unable to update application status."
                );

            }


            showMessage(
                "Application " +
                applicationNumber +
                " status updated to " +
                status +
                ".",
                "success"
            );


            await loadApplications();

        }
        catch (error) {

            console.error(
                "Status update error:",
                error
            );


            showMessage(
                error.message ||
                "Unable to update application status.",
                "error"
            );

        }
        finally {

            button.disabled =
                false;

            button.textContent =
                originalText;

        }

    }


    loginForm.addEventListener(
        "submit",
        async function (event) {

            event.preventDefault();


            clearLoginAlert();


            const email =
                emailInput.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();


            const password=[REDACTED]Administrator email and password are required.",
                    "error"
                );

                return;

            }


            loginButton.disabled =
                true;

            loginButton.textContent =
                "Signing in...";


            const controller =
                new AbortController();


            const timeoutId =
                window.setTimeout(
                    function () {

                        controller.abort();

                    },
                    30000
                );


            try {

                const response =
                    await fetch(
                        API_BASE +
                        "/auth/login",
                        {
                            method: "POST",
                            headers: {
                                "Content-Type":
                                    "application/json",
                                "Accept":
                                    "application/json"
                            },
                            body:
                                JSON.stringify({
                                    email:
                                        email,
                                    password:[REDACTED]Invalid administrator credentials."
                    );

                }


                const responseData =
                    data &&
                    data.data &&
                    typeof data.data === "object"
                        ? data.data
                        : data || {};


                const token =
                    responseData.token ||
                    responseData.accessToken;


                const role =
                    responseData.role ||
                    data.role ||
                    "";


                const fullName =
                    responseData.fullName ||
                    data.fullName ||
                    "Administrator";


                if (!token) {

                    throw new Error(
                        "Login succeeded, but the server did not return an authentication token."
                    );

                }


                if (
                    String(role)
                        .toUpperCase() !==
                    "ADMIN"
                ) {

                    throw new Error(
                        "Access denied. This account is not an administrator."
                    );

                }


                storeAuthentication(
                    token,
                    {
                        email:
                            email,
                        fullName:
                            fullName,
                        role:
                            role
                    }
                );


                showLoginAlert(
                    "Administrator authentication successful.",
                    "success"
                );


                window.setTimeout(
                    function () {

                        showDashboard();

                    },
                    400
                );

            }
            catch (error) {

                console.error(
                    "Admin login error:",
                    error
                );


                if (
                    error &&
                    error.name ===
                        "AbortError"
                ) {

                    showLoginAlert(
                        "Login request timed out after 30 seconds. Please try again.",
                        "error"
                    );

                }
                else {

                    showLoginAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Administrator login failed.",
                        "error"
                    );

                }

            }
            finally {

                window.clearTimeout(
                    timeoutId
                );

                loginButton.disabled =
                    false;

                loginButton.textContent =
                    "Administrator Sign In";

            }

        }
    );


    refreshApplications.addEventListener(
        "click",
        loadApplications
    );


    logoutButton.addEventListener(
        "click",
        function () {

            clearAuthentication();

            window.location.reload();

        }
    );


    /* =====================================================
       INITIAL PAGE CHECK
    ====================================================== */

    const existingToken =
        getToken();


    const existingUser =
        getStoredUser();


    if (
        existingToken &&
        isAdminUser(existingUser)
    ) {

        showDashboard();

    }
    else {

        if (existingToken) {

            clearAuthentication();

        }

        showLogin();

    }


})();

</script>


</body>

</html>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {

                const tableBody =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "applicationsTableBody"
                    );

                const tableArea =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "applicationsTableArea"
                    );

                const loading =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "applicationsLoading"
                    );

                const empty =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "applicationsEmpty"
                    );

                const message =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "applicationsMessage"
                    );

                const refreshButton =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "refreshApplications"
                    );


                const totalElement =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "totalApplications"
                    );

                const pendingElement =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "pendingApplications"
                    );

                const approvedElement =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "approvedApplications"
                    );

                const rejectedElement =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "rejectedApplications"
                    );


                function escapeHtml(value) {

                    if (
                        value === null ||
                        value === undefined
                    ) {
                        return "";
                    }

                    return String(value)
                        .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
                        .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
                        .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
                        .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
                        .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
                }


                function showMessage(
                    text,
                    type
                ) {

                    message.textContent =
                        text;

                    message.className =
                        "applications-message show " +
                        type;
                }


                function normalizeStatus(
                    status
                ) {

                    const value =
                        String(
                            status || "PENDING"
                        ).toUpperCase();

                    if (
                        value.includes("APPROV")
                    ) {
                        return "APPROVED";
                    }

                    if (
                        value.includes("REJECT")
                    ) {
                        return "REJECTED";
                    }

                    if (
                        value.includes("PROCESS")
                    ) {
                        return "PROCESSING";
                    }

                    return "PENDING";
                }


                function statusClass(
                    status
                ) {

                    const normalized =
                        normalizeStatus(status);

                    if (
                        normalized === "APPROVED"
                    ) {
                        return "status-approved";
                    }

                    if (
                        normalized === "REJECTED"
                    ) {
                        return "status-rejected";
                    }

                    if (
                        normalized === "PROCESSING"
                    ) {
                        return "status-processing";
                    }

                    return "status-pending";
                }


                function formatDate(
                    value
                ) {

                    if (!value) {
                        return "â€”";
                    }

                    const date =
                        new Date(value);

                    if (
                        Number.isNaN(
                            date.getTime()
                        )
                    ) {
                        return escapeHtml(value);
                    }

                    return date.toLocaleDateString(
                        "en-IN",
                        {
                            day: "2-digit",
                            month: "short",
                            year: "numeric"
                        }
                    );
                }


                function updateStats(
                    applications
                ) {

                    const list =
                        Array.isArray(applications)
                            ? applications
                            : [];


                    let pending = 0;
                    let approved = 0;
                    let rejected = 0;


                    list.forEach(
                        function (application) {

                            const status =
                                normalizeStatus(
                                    application.status
                                );


                            if (
                                status === "APPROVED"
                            ) {
                                approved++;
                            }
                            else if (
                                status === "REJECTED"
                            ) {
                                rejected++;
                            }
                            else {
                                pending++;
                            }

                        }
                    );


                    totalElement.textContent =
                        list.length;

                    pendingElement.textContent =
                        pending;

                    approvedElement.textContent =
                        approved;

                    rejectedElement.textContent =
                        rejected;
                }


                function renderApplications(
                    applications
                ) {

                    const list =
                        Array.isArray(applications)
                            ? applications
                            : [];


                    tableBody.innerHTML = "";


                    updateStats(list);


                    if (list.length === 0) {

                        tableArea.style.display =
                            "none";

                        empty.classList.add(
                            "show"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    empty.classList.remove(
                        "show"
                    );

                    tableArea.style.display =
                        "block";


                    list.forEach(
                        function (
                            application
                        ) {

                            const row =
                                document.createElement(
                                    "tr"
                                );


                            const applicationNumber =
                                application.applicationNumber ||
                                application.applicationNo ||
                                application.id ||
                                application.number ||
                                "â€”";


                            const applicant =
                                application.headOfFamily ||
                                application.applicantName ||
                                application.name ||
                                "â€”";


                            const cardType =
                                application.cardType ||
                                "â€”";


                            const district =
                                application.district ||
                                "â€”";


                            const submitted =
                                application.createdAt ||
                                application.submittedAt ||
                                application.applicationDate ||
                                application.date;


                            const status =
                                normalizeStatus(
                                    application.status
                                );


                            row.innerHTML = `

                                <td>
                                    <span class="application-number">
                                        ${escapeHtml(applicationNumber)}
                                    </span>
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    ${escapeHtml(applicant)}
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    ${escapeHtml(cardType)}
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    ${escapeHtml(district)}
                                </td>

                                <td class="application-date">
                                    ${formatDate(submitted)}
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    <span
                                        class="status-pill ${statusClass(status)}"
                                    >
                                        ${escapeHtml(status)}
                                    </span>
                                </td>

                                <td>
                                    <button
                                        type="button"
                                        class="view-application"
                                    >
                                        View
                                    </button>
                                </td>
                            `;


                            const viewButton =
                                row.querySelector(
                                    ".view-application"
                                );


                            viewButton.addEventListener(
                                "click",
                                function () {

                                    /*
                                     * Pass the application
                                     * identifier to the
                                     * status page.
                                     */

                                    const encoded =
                                        encodeURIComponent(
                                            applicationNumber
                                        );


                                    window.location.href =
                                        "application-status.html?application=" +
                                        encoded;

                                }
                            );


                            tableBody.appendChild(
                                row
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }


                async function loadApplications() {

                    const token =
                        localStorage.getItem(
                            "rationPortalToken"
                        );


                    if (!token) {

                        window.location.href =
                            "login.html";

                        return;
                    }


                    loading.classList.add(
                        "show"
                    );

                    tableArea.style.display =
                        "none";

                    empty.classList.remove(
                        "show"
                    );

                    message.className =
                        "applications-message";


                    try {

                        const apiBase =
                            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                        /*
                         * The frontend accepts the common
                         * application collection response
                         * formats used by the project.
                         */

                        const response =
                            await fetch(
                                apiBase +
                                "/applications",
                                {
                                    method: "GET",

                                    headers: {
                                        "Authorization":
                                            "Bearer " +
                                            token,

                                        "Accept":
                                            "application/json"
                                    }
                                }
                            );


                        if (
                            response.status === 401
                        ) {

                            localStorage.removeItem(
                                "rationPortalToken"
                            );

                            localStorage.removeItem(
                                "rationPortalUser"
                            );

                            window.location.href =
                                "login.html";

                            return;
                        }


                        let data = null;

                        try {

                            data =
                                await response.json();

                        }
                        catch (jsonError) {

                            data = null;

                        }


                        if (!response.ok) {

                            throw new Error(
                                data &&
                                (
                                    data.message ||
                                    data.error
                                )
                                    ? (
                                        data.message ||
                                        data.error
                                    )
                                    : "Unable to load applications."
                            );

                        }


                        let applications = [];


                        if (
                            Array.isArray(data)
                        ) {

                            applications =
                                data;

                        }
                        else if (
                            data &&
                            Array.isArray(
                                data.content
                            )
                        ) {

                            applications =
                                data.content;

                        }
                        else if (
                            data &&
                            Array.isArray(
                                data.applications
                            )
                        ) {

                            applications =
                                data.applications;

                        }
                        else if (
                            data &&
                            Array.isArray(
                                data.data
                            )
                        ) {

                            applications =
                                data.data;

                        }


                        renderApplications(
                            applications
                        );

                    }
                    catch (error) {

                        console.error(
                            "Applications error:",
                            error
                        );


                        tableArea.style.display =
                            "none";

                        empty.classList.remove(
                            "show"
                        );


                        showMessage(
                            error.message ||
                            "Unable to load your applications.",
                            "error"
                        );

                    }
                    finally {

                        loading.classList.remove(
                            "show"
                        );

                    }

                }


                refreshButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    loadApplications
                );


                loadApplications();


                const year =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "currentYear"
                    );

                if (year) {
                    year.textContent =
                        new Date().getFullYear();
                }

            }
        );
    </script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusSearchForm"
            );

        const input =
            document.getElementById(
                "applicationNumber"
            );

        const button =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusSearchButton"
            );

        const message =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusMessage"
            );

        const loading =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusLoading"
            );

        const empty =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusEmpty"
            );

        const result =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusResult"
            );


        function escapeHtml(value) {

            if (
                value === null ||
                value === undefined
            ) {
                return "";
            }

            return String(value)
                .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
                .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
                .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
                .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
                .replace(/'/g, "&#039;");
        }


        function formatDate(value) {

            if (!value) {
                return "â€”";
            }

            const date =
                new Date(value);

            if (
                Number.isNaN(
                    date.getTime()
                )
            ) {
                return String(value);
            }

            return date.toLocaleDateString(
                "en-IN",
                {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric"
                }
            );
        }


        function normalizeStatus(value) {

            const status =
                String(
                    value || "PENDING"
                ).toUpperCase();

            if (
                status.includes("APPROV")
            ) {
                return "APPROVED";
            }

            if (
                status.includes("REJECT")
            ) {
                return "REJECTED";
            }

            if (
                status.includes("PROCESS") ||
                status.includes("VERIF")
            ) {
                return "PROCESSING";
            }

            return "PENDING";
        }


        function showMessage(
            text,
            type
        ) {

            message.textContent =
                text;

            message.className =
                "status-message show " +
                type;
        }


        function resetView() {

            result.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );

            empty.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );

            message.className =
                "status-message";
        }


        function updateStatusBadge(
            status
        ) {

            const badge =
                document.getElementById(
                    "mainStatus"
                );

            const normalized =
                normalizeStatus(status);

            badge.textContent =
                normalized;

            badge.className =
                "main-status " +
                normalized.toLowerCase();
        }


        function updateTimeline(
            application
        ) {

            const status =
                normalizeStatus(
                    application.status
                );


            const submitted =
                document.getElementById(
                    "timelineSubmitted"
                );

            const verification =
                document.getElementById(
                    "timelineVerification"
                );

            const decision =
                document.getElementById(
                    "timelineDecision"
                );

            const completion =
                document.getElementById(
                    "timelineCompletion"
                );


            submitted.className =
                "timeline-item completed";


            verification.className =
                "timeline-item";


            decision.className =
                "timeline-item";


            completion.className =
                "timeline-item";


            const submittedDate =
                document.getElementById(
                    "timelineSubmittedDate"
                );

            submittedDate.textContent =
                formatDate(
                    application.createdAt ||
                    application.submittedAt ||
                    application.applicationDate
                );


            if (
                status === "PROCESSING"
            ) {

                verification.className =
                    "timeline-item current";

            }
            else if (
                status === "APPROVED"
            ) {

                verification.className =
                    "timeline-item completed";

                decision.className =
                    "timeline-item completed";

                completion.className =
                    "timeline-item current";

            }
            else if (
                status === "REJECTED"
            ) {

                verification.className =
                    "timeline-item completed";

                decision.className =
                    "timeline-item current";

            }
            else {

                verification.className =
                    "timeline-item current";

            }

        }


        function renderResult(
            application,
            requestedNumber
        ) {

            const applicationNumber =
                application.applicationNumber ||
                application.applicationNo ||
                application.number ||
                application.id ||
                requestedNumber;


            const applicant =
                application.headOfFamily ||
                application.applicantName ||
                application.name ||
                "â€”";


            const cardType =
                application.cardType ||
                "â€”";


            const district =
                application.district ||
                "â€”";


            const submitted =
                application.createdAt ||
                application.submittedAt ||
                application.applicationDate ||
                application.date;


            document.getElementById(
                "resultApplicationNumber"
            ).textContent =
                "Application Number: " +
                applicationNumber;


            document.getElementById(
                "resultApplicant"
            ).textContent =
                applicant;


            document.getElementById(
                "resultCardType"
            ).textContent =
                cardType;


            document.getElementById(
                "resultDistrict"
            ).textContent =
                district;


            document.getElementById(
                "resultSubmitted"
            ).textContent =
                formatDate(submitted);


            updateStatusBadge(
                application.status
            );


            updateTimeline(
                application
            );


            result.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

        }


        async function searchApplication(
            applicationNumber
        ) {

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return;

            }


            resetView();


            loading.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

            button.disabled =
                true;

            button.textContent =
                "Checking...";


            try {

                const apiBase =
                    window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                    "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                const encodedNumber =
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        applicationNumber
                    );


                /*
                 * Primary endpoint for the
                 * authenticated application.
                 */
                let response =
                    await fetch(
                        apiBase +
                        "/applications/ration-card/" +
                        encodedNumber,
                        {
                            method: "GET",

                            headers: {
                                "Authorization":
                                    "Bearer " +
                                    token,

                                "Accept":
                                    "application/json"
                            }
                        }
                    );


                if (
                    response.status === 401
                ) {

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalToken"
                    );

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    );

                    window.location.href =
                        "login.html";

                    return;
                }


                let data = null;


                try {

                    data =
                        await response.json();

                }
                catch (jsonError) {

                    data = null;

                }


                if (!response.ok) {

                    if (
                        response.status === 404
                    ) {

                        empty.classList.add(
                            "show"
                        );

                        return;

                    }


                    throw new Error(
                        data &&
                        (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                            ? (
                                data.message ||
                                data.error
                            )
                            : "Unable to retrieve application status."
                    );

                }


                /*
                 * Some API responses wrap the
                 * application in a data property.
                 */
                const application =
                    data &&
                    data.data &&
                    !Array.isArray(data.data)
                        ? data.data
                        : data;


                if (
                    !application ||
                    typeof application !== "object"
                ) {

                    empty.classList.add(
                        "show"
                    );

                    return;
                }


                renderResult(
                    application,
                    applicationNumber
                );


                showMessage(
                    "Application status loaded successfully.",
                    "success"
                );

            }
            catch (error) {

                console.error(
                    "Application status error:",
                    error
                );


                showMessage(
                    error.message ||
                    "Unable to retrieve application status.",
                    "error"
                );

            }
            finally {

                loading.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

                button.disabled =
                    false;

                button.textContent =
                    "Check Status";

            }

        }


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                const applicationNumber =
                    input.value.trim();


                if (!applicationNumber) {

                    showMessage(
                        "Please enter an application number.",
                        "error"
                    );

                    return;
                }


                searchApplication(
                    applicationNumber
                );

            }
        );


        /*
         * Automatically read an application
         * number from:
         *
         * application-status.html?application=XXXX
         */
        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(
                window.location.search
            );


        const queryNumber =
            params.get(
                "application"
            );


        if (queryNumber) {

            input.value =
                queryNumber;

            searchApplication(
                queryNumber
            );

        }


        const year =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (year) {
            year.textContent =
                new Date().getFullYear();
        }

    }
);
</script>

</body>
</html>

    <script>
        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {

            const form =
                document.getElementById(
                    "rationApplicationForm"
                );

            const membersBody =
                document.getElementById(
                    "familyMembersBody"
                );

            const addMemberButton =
                document.getElementById(
                    "addMemberButton"
                );

            const totalMembers =
                document.getElementById(
                    "totalMembers"
                );

            const adultMembers =
                document.getElementById(
                    "adultMembers"
                );

            const childMembers =
                document.getElementById(
                    "childMembers"
                );

            const message =
                document.getElementById(
                    "applicationMessage"
                );

            const submitButton =
                document.getElementById(
                    "submitApplicationButton"
                );


            let memberCount = 0;


            function showMessage(
                text,
                type
            ) {

                message.textContent = text;

                message.className =
                    "application-message show " +
                    type;

                window.scrollTo({
                    top: 0,
                    behavior: "smooth"
                });
            }


            function createMemberRow() {

                memberCount++;

                const row =
                    document.createElement("tr");

                row.innerHTML = `
                    <td>
                        <span class="member-number">
                            ${memberCount}
                        </span>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <input
                            type="text"
                            class="member-name"
                            placeholder="Member name"
                            maxlength="100"
                            required
                        >
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <input
                            type="number"
                            class="member-age"
                            min="0"
                            max="120"
                            placeholder="Age"
                            required
                        >
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <select
                            class="member-gender"
                            required
                        >
                            <option value="">
                                Select
                            </option>
                            <option value="MALE">
                                Male
                            </option>
                            <option value="FEMALE">
                                Female
                            </option>
                            <option value="OTHER">
                                Other
                            </option>
                        </select>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <select
                            class="member-relationship"
                            required
                        >
                            <option value="">
                                Select
                            </option>
                            <option value="HEAD">
                                Head
                            </option>
                            <option value="SPOUSE">
                                Spouse
                            </option>
                            <option value="SON">
                                Son
                            </option>
                            <option value="DAUGHTER">
                                Daughter
                            </option>
                            <option value="PARENT">
                                Parent
                            </option>
                            <option value="SIBLING">
                                Sibling
                            </option>
                            <option value="OTHER">
                                Other
                            </option>
                        </select>
                    </td>

                    <td>
                        <button
                            type="button"
                            class="remove-member"
                            title="Remove member"
                            aria-label="Remove member"
                        >
                            Ã—
                        </button>
                    </td>
                `;


                const removeButton =
                    row.querySelector(
                        ".remove-member"
                    );

                removeButton.addEventListener(
                    "click",
                    function () {

                        row.remove();

                        renumberMembers();

                        updateSummary();

                    }
                );


                const ageInput =
                    row.querySelector(
                        ".member-age"
                    );

                ageInput.addEventListener(
                    "input",
                    updateSummary
                );


                membersBody.appendChild(row);

                updateSummary();
            }


            function renumberMembers() {

                const rows =
                    membersBody.querySelectorAll("tr");

                rows.forEach(
                    function (row, index) {

                        const number =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".member-number"
                            );

                        if (number) {
                            number.textContent =
                                index + 1;
                        }

                    }
                );

                memberCount =
                    rows.length;
            }


            function updateSummary() {

                const rows =
                    membersBody.querySelectorAll("tr");

                let adults = 0;
                let children = 0;

                rows.forEach(
                    function (row) {

                        const ageInput =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".member-age"
                            );

                        const age =
                            Number(
                                ageInput.value
                            );

                        if (
                            Number.isFinite(age) &&
                            age >= 18
                        ) {
                            adults++;
                        }
                        else if (
                            Number.isFinite(age) &&
                            age >= 0 &&
                            age !== 0
                        ) {
                            children++;
                        }

                    }
                );

                totalMembers.textContent =
                    rows.length;

                adultMembers.textContent =
                    adults;

                childMembers.textContent =
                    children;
            }


            addMemberButton.addEventListener(
                "click",
                createMemberRow
            );


            /*
             * Start with one family member row.
             */
            createMemberRow();


            form.addEventListener(
                "reset",
                function () {

                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            membersBody.innerHTML = "";

                            memberCount = 0;

                            createMemberRow();

                            updateSummary();

                        },
                        0
                    );

                }
            );


            form.addEventListener(
                "submit",
                async function (event) {

                    event.preventDefault();


                    const headOfFamily =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "headOfFamily"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const mobile =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "mobile"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const email =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "email"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const cardType =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "cardType"
                        ).value;

                    const address =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "address"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const district =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "district"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const state =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "state"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const pincode =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "pincode"
                        ).value.trim();

                    const declaration =
                        document.getElementById(
                            "declaration"
                        );


                    if (!headOfFamily) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please enter the head of family name.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    if (!/^[6-9][0-9]{9}$/.test(mobile)) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    if (
                        email &&
                        !/^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(
                            email
                        )
                    ) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please enter a valid email address.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    if (!cardType) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please select a ration card type.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    if (!address || !district || !state) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please complete the address details.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    if (!/^[0-9]{6}$/.test(pincode)) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please enter a valid 6-digit PIN code.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    const rows =
                        membersBody.querySelectorAll("tr");


                    if (rows.length === 0) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please add at least one family member.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    const familyMembers = [];


                    for (
                        const row of rows
                    ) {

                        const name =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".member-name"
                            ).value.trim();

                        const age =
                            Number(
                                row.querySelector(
                                    ".member-age"
                                ).value
                            );

                        const gender =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".member-gender"
                            ).value;

                        const relationship =
                            row.querySelector(
                                ".member-relationship"
                            ).value;


                        if (
                            !name ||
                            !Number.isFinite(age) ||
                            age < 0 ||
                            age > 120 ||
                            !gender ||
                            !relationship
                        ) {

                            showMessage(
                                "Please complete every family member row.",
                                "error"
                            );

                            return;
                        }


                        familyMembers.push({
                            name: name,
                            age: age,
                            gender: gender,
                            relationship: relationship
                        });

                    }


                    if (!declaration.checked) {

                        showMessage(
                            "Please accept the declaration before submitting.",
                            "error"
                        );

                        return;
                    }


                    /*
                     * The backend currently exposes the
                     * ration-card application route.
                     *
                     * Keep the payload clean and compatible
                     * with the existing API integration.
                     */

                    const payload = {

                        headOfFamily:
                            headOfFamily,

                        mobile:
                            mobile,

                        email:
                            email || null,

                        cardType:
                            cardType,

                        address:
                            address,

                        district:
                            district,

                        state:
                            state,

                        pincode:
                            pincode,

                        familyMembers:
                            familyMembers

                    };


                    submitButton.disabled = true;

                    submitButton.textContent =
                        "Submitting...";

                    message.className =
                        "application-message";


                    try {

                        const token =
                            localStorage.getItem(
                                "rationPortalToken"
                            );


                        if (!token) {

                            window.location.href =
                                "login.html";

                            return;
                        }


                        const apiBase =
                            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                        /*
                         * The application endpoint uses
                         * the authenticated user's ration
                         * application route.
                         *
                         * If the backend requests a ration
                         * number before submission, the user
                         * can continue through Applications.
                         */

                        const response =
                            await fetch(
                                apiBase +
                                "/applications/ration-card",
                                {
                                    method: "POST",

                                    headers: {
                                        "Content-Type":
                                            "application/json",

                                        "Authorization":
                                            "Bearer " + token
                                    },

                                    body:
                                        JSON.stringify(
                                            payload
                                        )
                                }
                            );


                        let data = null;

                        try {

                            data =
                                await response.json();

                        }
                        catch (jsonError) {

                            data = null;

                        }


                        if (!response.ok) {

                            const errorMessage =
                                data &&
                                (
                                    data.message ||
                                    data.error
                                )
                                    ? (
                                        data.message ||
                                        data.error
                                    )
                                    : "Application submission failed.";

                            throw new Error(
                                errorMessage
                            );
                        }


                        showMessage(
                            "Application submitted successfully.",
                            "success"
                        );


                        submitButton.textContent =
                            "Submitted";


                        setTimeout(
                            function () {

                                window.location.href =
                                    "applications.html";

                            },
                            900
                        );

                    }
                    catch (error) {

                        console.error(
                            "Application submission error:",
                            error
                        );


                        showMessage(
                            error.message ||
                            "Unable to submit the application. Please try again.",
                            "error"
                        );


                        submitButton.disabled =
                            false;

                        submitButton.textContent =
                            "Submit Application";

                    }

                }
            );


            const year =
                document.getElementById(
                    "currentYear"
                );

            if (year) {
                year.textContent =
                    new Date().getFullYear();
            }

        });
    </script>

</body>
</html>

    /* =========================================================
       FONT SIZE
       ========================================================= */

    let fontScale = 100;


    function setFont(value) {

        fontScale =
            Math.max(
                85,
                Math.min(
                    125,
                    value
                )
            );


        document.documentElement.style.fontSize =
            fontScale + "%";

    }


    function changeFont(amount) {

        setFont(
            fontScale + amount
        );

    }


    /* =========================================================
       LOGOUT
       ========================================================= */

    document
        .getElementById("logoutButton")
        .addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalUser"
                );

                window.location.href =
                    "../index.html";

            }
        );


    /* =========================================================
       SEARCH
       ========================================================= */

    document
        .getElementById("rationSearchForm")
        .addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                const value =
                    document
                        .getElementById(
                            "rationSearch"
                        )
                        .value
                        .trim();


                if (!value) {

                    alert(
                        "Please enter a Ration Card Number or Member ID."
                    );

                    return;

                }


                window.location.href =
                    "search.html?q=" +
                    encodeURIComponent(value);

            }
        );


    /* =========================================================
       DEMO ACCOUNT DISPLAY
       ========================================================= */

    document.addEventListener(
        "DOMContentLoaded",
        function () {

            /*
             * The backend-connected user information
             * will replace these demonstration values
             * when authentication integration is completed.
             */

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                /*
                 * Do not force redirect yet.
                 * Authentication enforcement is handled
                 * in the authentication stage.
                 */

            }

        }
    );

</script>
