    <script>
        "use strict";

        const API_BASE =
            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";

        function getToken() {
            return localStorage.getItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );
        }

        function authenticatedFetch(
            url,
            options = {}
        ) {
            const token = getToken();

            const headers = {
                ...(options.headers || {})
            };

            if (token) {
                headers.Authorization =
                    "Bearer " + token;
            }

            headers.Accept =
                "application/json";

            return fetch(url, {
                ...options,
                headers
            });
        }

        function getCurrentUser() {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(
                    localStorage.getItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    ) || "null"
                );
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function firstValue(
            object,
            keys,
            fallback = null
        ) {
            if (!object) {
                return fallback;
            }

            for (const key of keys) {
                if (
                    object[key] !== undefined &&
                    object[key] !== null &&
                    object[key] !== ""
                ) {
                    return object[key];
                }
            }

            return fallback;
        }

        function normalizeRecords(
            response
        ) {
            if (Array.isArray(response)) {
                return response;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.distributionLogs
                )
            ) {
                return response.distributionLogs;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.distributionHistory
                )
            ) {
                return response.distributionHistory;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.records
                )
            ) {
                return response.records;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                response.data
            ) {
                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data;
                }

                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data.distributionLogs
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data.distributionLogs;
                }

                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data.distributionHistory
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data.distributionHistory;
                }

                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data.records
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data.records;
                }
            }

            return [];
        }

        function getDate(
            record
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                record,
                [
                    "distributionDate",
                    "distribution_date",
                    "date",
                    "transactionDate",
                    "transaction_date"
                ],
                null
            );
        }

        function getQuantity(
            record
        ) {
            return Number(
                firstValue(
                    record,
                    [
                        "quantity",
                        "riceQuantity",
                        "rice_quantity",
                        "distributedQuantity",
                        "distributed_quantity"
                    ],
                    0
                )
            ) || 0;
        }

        function getFpsId(
            record
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                record,
                [
                    "fpsId",
                    "fps_id",
                    "fps",
                    "fairPriceShopId",
                    "fair_price_shop_id"
                ],
                "â€”"
            );
        }

        function getStatus(
            record
        ) {
            return String(
                firstValue(
                    record,
                    [
                        "transactionStatus",
                        "transaction_status",
                        "status"
                    ],
                    "Unknown"
                )
            );
        }

        function getTransactionId(
            record
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                record,
                [
                    "transactionId",
                    "transaction_id",
                    "id",
                    "distributionId",
                    "distribution_id"
                ],
                "â€”"
            );
        }

        function formatDate(
            value
        ) {
            if (!value) {
                return "â€”";
            }

            const date =
                new Date(value);

            if (
                Number.isNaN(
                    date.getTime()
                )
            ) {
                return String(value);
            }

            return date.toLocaleDateString(
                "en-IN",
                {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric"
                }
            );
        }

        function statusClass(
            status
        ) {
            const normalized =
                String(status)
                    .toLowerCase();

            if (
                normalized.includes(
                    "success"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "complete"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "distributed"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "approved"
                )
            ) {
                return "status-success";
            }

            if (
                normalized.includes(
                    "pending"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "process"
                )
            ) {
                return "status-pending";
            }

            if (
                normalized.includes(
                    "failed"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "reject"
                ) ||
                normalized.includes(
                    "cancel"
                )
            ) {
                return "status-failed";
            }

            return "status-pending";
        }

        function escapeHtml(
            value
        ) {
            return String(value)
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&amp;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /</g,
                    "&lt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    />/g,
                    "&gt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    "&quot;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /'/g,
                    "&#039;"
                );
        }

        function showError(
            message
        ) {
            document.getElementById(
                "loadingBox"
            ).style.display =
                "none";

            const errorBox =
                document.getElementById(
                    "errorBox"
                );

            errorBox.textContent =
                message;

            errorBox.style.display =
                "block";
        }

        function renderRecords(
            records
        ) {
            const body =
                document.getElementById(
                    "distributionTableBody"
                );

            body.innerHTML = "";

            if (
                !records ||
                records.length === 0
            ) {
                document.getElementById(
                    "loadingBox"
                ).style.display =
                    "none";

                document.getElementById(
                    "emptyState"
                ).style.display =
                    "block";

                return;
            }

            const sorted =
                [...records].sort(
                    function (a, b) {

                        const dateA =
                            new Date(
                                getDate(a) ||
                                0
                            ).getTime();

                        const dateB =
                            new Date(
                                getDate(b) ||
                                0
                            ).getTime();

                        return (
                            dateB -
                            dateA
                        );
                    }
                );

            let totalRice = 0;
            let completed = 0;

            sorted.forEach(
                function (record) {

                    const date =
                        getDate(record);

                    const quantity =
                        getQuantity(
                            record
                        );

                    const fpsId =
                        getFpsId(
                            record
                        );

                    const status =
                        getStatus(
                            record
                        );

                    const transactionId =
                        getTransactionId(
                            record
                        );

                    totalRice +=
                        quantity;

                    const normalizedStatus =
                        status.toLowerCase();

                    if (
                        normalizedStatus.includes(
                            "success"
                        ) ||
                        normalizedStatus.includes(
                            "complete"
                        ) ||
                        normalizedStatus.includes(
                            "distributed"
                        ) ||
                        normalizedStatus.includes(
                            "approved"
                        )
                    ) {
                        completed++;
                    }

                    const row =
                        document.createElement(
                            "tr"
                        );

                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <td>
                            <span class="date-value">
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    formatDate(date)
                                )}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="quantity">
                                ${quantity}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="fps-id">
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    fpsId
                                )}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="status-pill ${statusClass(status)}">
                                <span class="status-dot"></span>
                                ${escapeHtml(status)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${escapeHtml(
                                transactionId
                            )}
                        </td>
                    `;

                    body.appendChild(
                        row
                    );
                }
            );

            document.getElementById(
                "totalRice"
            ).textContent =
                totalRice;

            document.getElementById(
                "completedTransactions"
            ).textContent =
                completed;

            document.getElementById(
                "latestDistribution"
            ).textContent =
                formatDate(
                    getDate(
                        sorted[0]
                    )
                );

            document.getElementById(
                "loadingBox"
            ).style.display =
                "none";

            document.getElementById(
                "tableWrapper"
            ).style.display =
                "block";
        }

        async function loadDistribution() {

            const user =
                getCurrentUser();

            const rationCardNumber =
                firstValue(
                    user,
                    [
                        "rationCardNumber",
                        "ration_card_number",
                        "cardNumber",
                        "rationId",
                        "ration_id"
                    ]
                );

            const memberId =
                firstValue(
                    user,
                    [
                        "memberId",
                        "member_id"
                    ]
                );

            let endpoint = null;

            /*
             * Prefer ration-card-specific distribution
             * records when the logged-in user has a card number.
             */
            if (
                rationCardNumber
            ) {
                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/distribution-logs/ration-card/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        rationCardNumber
                    );
            } else if (
                memberId
            ) {
                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/distribution-logs/member/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        memberId
                    );
            } else {
                showError(
                    "Your account does not currently contain a ration card or member identifier. Please contact the administrator."
                );

                return;
            }

            try {

                const response =
                    await authenticatedFetch(
                        endpoint
                    );

                if (
                    response.status === 401 ||
                    response.status === 403
                ) {
                    if (
                        window.authGuard &&
                        typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                            "function"
                    ) {
                        window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                    }

                    return;
                }

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Unable to load distribution history."
                    );
                }

                const data =
                    await response.json();

                const records =
                    normalizeRecords(
                        data
                    );

                renderRecords(
                    records
                );

            } catch (error) {

                console.error(
                    "Distribution loading error:",
                    error
                );

                showError(
                    "Rice distribution history could not be loaded from the server yet. Please make sure distribution records are available for your ration card."
                );
            }
        }

        function updateDate() {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    "currentDate"
                );

            const now =
                new Date();

            element.textContent =
                now.toLocaleDateString(
                    "en-IN",
                    {
                        weekday: "short",
                        day: "2-digit",
                        month: "short",
                        year: "numeric"
                    }
                );
        }

        function logoutCitizen() {

            if (
                window.authGuard &&
                typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                    "function"
            ) {
                window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                return;
            }

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalUser"
            );

            window.location.href =
                "login.html";
        }

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {

                updateDate();

                loadDistribution();

            }
        );
    </script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
(function () {
    "use strict";

    const API_BASE =
        window.RATION_API_BASE ||
        "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";

    const tokenKey = "rationPortalToken";
    const userKey = "rationPortalUser";

    const input =
        document.getElementById("rationNumberInput");

    const loadButton =
        document.getElementById("loadCardButton");

    const loadingMessage =
        document.getElementById("loadingMessage");

    const statusMessage =
        document.getElementById("statusMessage");

    const cardSection =
        document.getElementById("cardSection");

    const familyTableBody =
        document.getElementById("familyTableBody");

    const familyEmpty =
        document.getElementById("familyEmpty");

    const qrCanvas =
        document.getElementById("qrCanvas");

    function getToken() {
        return localStorage.getItem(tokenKey) || "";
    }

    function getStoredUser() {
        try {
            const raw =
                localStorage.getItem(userKey);

            return raw ? JSON.parse(raw) : null;
        } catch (error) {
            return null;
        }
    }

    function getUserRationNumber() {
        const user = getStoredUser();

        if (!user) {
            return "";
        }

        return (
            user.rationCardNumber ||
            user.ration_card_number ||
            user.rationNumber ||
            user.ration_number ||
            ""
        );
    }

    function showStatus(message, type) {
        statusMessage.textContent = message;
        statusMessage.className =
            "status-message show " + type;
    }

    function hideStatus() {
        statusMessage.textContent = "";
        statusMessage.className =
            "status-message";
    }

    function setLoading(isLoading) {
        loadingMessage.classList.toggle(
            "show",
            isLoading
        );

        loadButton.disabled = isLoading;

        loadButton.textContent =
            isLoading
                ? "Loading..."
                : "View e-Ration Card";
    }

    function cleanValue(value) {
        if (
            value === null ||
            value === undefined ||
            value === ""
        ) {
            return "â€”";
        }

        return String(value);
    }

    function firstValue(object, keys) {
        if (!object || typeof object !== "object") {
            return null;
        }

        for (const key of keys) {
            if (
                Object.prototype.hasOwnProperty.call(
                    object,
                    key
                ) &&
                object[key] !== null &&
                object[key] !== undefined &&
                object[key] !== ""
            ) {
                return object[key];
            }
        }

        return null;
    }

    function extractRecord(payload) {
        if (!payload) {
            return null;
        }

        if (payload.data) {
            return payload.data;
        }

        if (payload.rationCard) {
            return payload.rationCard;
        }

        if (payload.ration_card) {
            return payload.ration_card;
        }

        return payload;
    }

    function extractMembers(record, payload) {
        const possibleArrays = [
            record && record.familyMembers,
            record && record.family_members,
            record && record.members,
            payload && payload.familyMembers,
            payload && payload.family_members,
            payload && payload.members
        ];

        for (const value of possibleArrays) {
            if (Array.isArray(value)) {
                return value;
            }
        }

        return [];
    }

    function normalizeCard(record) {
        return {
            id: firstValue(record, [
                "id",
                "rationCardId",
                "ration_card_id"
            ]),
            number: firstValue(record, [
                "rationCardNumber",
                "ration_card_number",
                "rationNumber",
                "ration_number",
                "cardNumber",
                "card_number"
            ]),

            type: firstValue(record, [
                "cardType",
                "card_type",
                "type"
            ]),

            head: firstValue(record, [
                "headOfFamily",
                "head_of_family",
                "headName",
                "head_name",
                "name"
            ]),

            status: firstValue(record, [
                "status",
                "cardStatus",
                "card_status"
            ]),

            address: firstValue(record, [
                "address",
                "fullAddress"
            ]),

            district: firstValue(record, [
                "district",
                "districtName",
                "district_name"
            ]),

            state: firstValue(record, [
                "state",
                "stateName",
                "state_name"
            ]),

            recordStatus: firstValue(record, [
                "recordStatus",
                "record_status"
            ]),

            adultRice: firstValue(record, [
                "adultRice",
                "adult_rice",
                "adultRiceQuota",
                "adult_rice_quota"
            ]),

            childRice: firstValue(record, [
                "childRice",
                "child_rice",
                "childRiceQuota",
                "child_rice_quota"
            ]),

            totalRice: firstValue(record, [
                "totalRice",
                "total_rice",
                "rice",
                "riceQuota",
                "rice_quota"
            ]),

            verified: record && record.verified === true
        };
    }

    function renderCard(card) {
        document.getElementById("cardNumber").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.number);

        document.getElementById("cardType").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.type);

        document.getElementById("headOfFamily").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.head);

        document.getElementById("cardStatus").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.status);

        document.getElementById("cardAddress").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.address);

        document.getElementById("cardDistrict").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.district);

        document.getElementById("cardState").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.state);

        document.getElementById("recordStatus").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.recordStatus);

        document.getElementById("adultRice").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.adultRice);

        document.getElementById("childRice").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.childRice);

        document.getElementById("totalRice").textContent =
            cleanValue(card.totalRice);

        const recordLabel =
            document.getElementById("recordLabel");

        recordLabel.textContent =
            card.verified
                ? "Verified by Backend"
                : "Government Record";
    }

    function calculateQuotaSummary(members) {
        let adultRice = 0;
        let childRice = 0;
        let totalRice = 0;

        if (!Array.isArray(members)) {
            return { adultRice: null, childRice: null, totalRice: null };
        }

        members.forEach(function (member) {
            const age = Number(firstValue(member, ["age"]));
            const quotaValue = firstValue(member, [
                "riceQuotaKg",
                "rice_quota_kg",
                "riceQuota",
                "rice_quota",
                "rice"
            ]);
            const quota = Number(quotaValue);

            if (!Number.isFinite(quota)) {
                return;
            }

            totalRice += quota;

            if (Number.isFinite(age)) {
                if (age >= 18) {
                    adultRice += quota;
                } else {
                    childRice += quota;
                }
            }
        });

        return {
            adultRice: adultRice.toFixed(2) + " kg",
            childRice: childRice.toFixed(2) + " kg",
            totalRice: totalRice.toFixed(2) + " kg"
        };
    }

    function renderFamilyMembers(members) {
        familyTableBody.replaceChildren();

        if (!Array.isArray(members) || members.length === 0) {
            familyEmpty.style.display = "block";
            return;
        }

        familyEmpty.style.display = "none";

        members.forEach(function (member) {
            const name =
                firstValue(member, [
                    "name",
                    "memberName",
                    "member_name"
                ]);

            const age =
                firstValue(member, [
                    "age"
                ]);

            const gender =
                firstValue(member, [
                    "gender",
                    "sex"
                ]);

            const relationship =
                firstValue(member, [
                    "relationship",
                    "relation"
                ]);

            const rice =
                firstValue(member, [
                    "riceQuotaKg",
                    "rice_quota_kg",
                    "riceQuota",
                    "rice_quota",
                    "rice"
                ]);

            const numericAge =
                Number(age);

            let category = "â€”";

            if (Number.isFinite(numericAge)) {
                category =
                    numericAge >= 18
                        ? "Adult"
                        : "Child";
            }

            const row =
                document.createElement("tr");

            const nameCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            nameCell.textContent =
                cleanValue(name);

            const ageCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            ageCell.textContent =
                cleanValue(age);

            const genderCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            genderCell.textContent =
                cleanValue(gender);

            const relationCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            relationCell.textContent =
                cleanValue(relationship);

            const categoryCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            const badge =
                document.createElement("span");

            badge.textContent = category;

            badge.className =
                category === "Adult"
                    ? "category-badge category-adult"
                    : category === "Child"
                        ? "category-badge category-child"
                        : "category-badge";

            categoryCell.appendChild(badge);

            const riceCell =
                document.createElement("td");

            riceCell.textContent =
                cleanValue(rice);

            row.appendChild(nameCell);
            row.appendChild(ageCell);
            row.appendChild(genderCell);
            row.appendChild(relationCell);
            row.appendChild(categoryCell);
            row.appendChild(riceCell);

            familyTableBody.appendChild(row);
        });
    }

    async function authenticatedGet(url) {
        const token = getToken();

        if (!token) {
            throw new Error(
                "Your citizen session has expired. Please sign in again."
            );
        }

        const response =
            await fetch(url, {
                method: "GET",
                headers: {
                    "Accept": "application/json",
                    "Authorization":
                        "Bearer " + token
                }
            });

        if (response.status === 401) {
            localStorage.removeItem(tokenKey);
            localStorage.removeItem(userKey);

            window.location.href =
                "login.html";

            throw new Error(
                "Your session has expired."
            );
        }

        if (!response.ok) {
            let message =
                "Unable to load the ration card.";

            try {
                const errorBody =
                    await response.json();

                message =
                    errorBody.message ||
                    errorBody.error ||
                    message;
            } catch (error) {
                // Keep default message.
            }

            throw new Error(message);
        }

        return response.json();
    }

    async function loadFamilyIfRequired(
        rationCardId,
        record,
        payload
    ) {
        const embeddedMembers =
            extractMembers(record, payload);

        if (embeddedMembers.length > 0) {
            return embeddedMembers;
        }

        if (rationCardId === null || rationCardId === undefined || rationCardId === "") {
            return [];
        }

        try {
            const url =
                API_BASE +
                "/family-members/ration-card/" +
                encodeURIComponent(rationCardId);

            const response =
                await authenticatedGet(url);

            if (Array.isArray(response)) {
                return response;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(response.data)
            ) {
                return response.data;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(response.members)
            ) {
                return response.members;
            }

            return [];
        } catch (error) {
            return [];
        }
    }

    function generateQr(rationNumber) {
        const context =
            window.location;

        const verificationUrl =
            context.origin +
            context.pathname +
            "?rationNumber=" +
            encodeURIComponent(rationNumber);

        if (
            typeof QRCode === "undefined" ||
            typeof QRCode.toCanvas !== "function"
        ) {
            const ctx =
                qrCanvas.getContext("2d");

            ctx.clearRect(
                0,
                0,
                qrCanvas.width,
                qrCanvas.height
            );

            ctx.font =
                "12px Segoe UI";

            ctx.fillStyle =
                "#667085";

            ctx.textAlign =
                "center";

            ctx.fillText(
                "QR library unavailable",
                qrCanvas.width / 2,
                qrCanvas.height / 2
            );

            return;
        }

        QRCode.toCanvas(
            qrCanvas,
            verificationUrl,
            {
                width: 190,
                margin: 2,
                errorCorrectionLevel: "M"
            },
            function (error) {
                if (error) {
                    console.error(
                        "QR generation failed:",
                        error
                    );
                }
            }
        );
    }

    async function loadCard(rationNumber) {
        const number =
            String(rationNumber || "").trim();

        if (!number) {
            showStatus(
                "Please enter a ration card number.",
                "error"
            );

            input.focus();

            return;
        }

        hideStatus();
        setLoading(true);

        try {
            const url =
                API_BASE +
                "/ration-cards/" +
                encodeURIComponent(number);

            const payload =
                await authenticatedGet(url);

            const record =
                extractRecord(payload);

            if (
                !record ||
                typeof record !== "object"
            ) {
                throw new Error(
                    "The backend returned an invalid ration card record."
                );
            }

            const card =
                normalizeCard(record);

            renderCard(card);

            const members =
                await loadFamilyIfRequired(
                    card.id,
                    record,
                    payload
                );

            renderFamilyMembers(members);

            const quotaSummary = calculateQuotaSummary(members);

            if (card.adultRice === null || card.adultRice === undefined || card.adultRice === "") {
                document.getElementById("adultRice").textContent =
                    quotaSummary.adultRice || "â€”";
            }

            if (card.childRice === null || card.childRice === undefined || card.childRice === "") {
                document.getElementById("childRice").textContent =
                    quotaSummary.childRice || "â€”";
            }

            if (card.totalRice === null || card.totalRice === undefined || card.totalRice === "") {
                document.getElementById("totalRice").textContent =
                    quotaSummary.totalRice || "â€”";
            }

            generateQr(
                card.number || number
            );

            cardSection.classList.add("show");

            showStatus(
                "Ration card record loaded successfully.",
                "info"
            );

            cardSection.scrollIntoView({
                behavior: "smooth",
                block: "start"
            });

        } catch (error) {
            cardSection.classList.remove("show");

            familyTableBody.replaceChildren();

            familyEmpty.style.display =
                "block";

            showStatus(
                error.message ||
                "Unable to load the ration card record.",
                "error"
            );
        } finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    }

    function initializeInput() {
        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(
                window.location.search
            );

        const queryNumber =
            params.get("rationNumber") ||
            params.get("ration") ||
            "";

        const userNumber =
            getUserRationNumber();

        const initialNumber =
            queryNumber || userNumber;

        if (initialNumber) {
            input.value =
                initialNumber;

            loadCard(initialNumber);
        }
    }

    function setupFontControls() {
        const body =
            document.body;

        document
            .getElementById("fontSmall")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {
                    body.style.fontSize =
                        "92%";
                }
            );

        document
            .getElementById("fontNormal")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {
                    body.style.fontSize =
                        "100%";
                }
            );

        document
            .getElementById("fontLarge")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {
                    body.style.fontSize =
                        "108%";
                }
            );
    }

    function setupDate() {
        const dateElement =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentDate"
            );

        const now =
            new Date();

        dateElement.textContent =
            now.toLocaleDateString(
                "en-IN",
                {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric"
                }
            );
    }

    function setupButtons() {
        loadButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {
                loadCard(input.value);
            }
        );

        input.addEventListener(
            "keydown",
            function (event) {
                if (event.key === "Enter") {
                    event.preventDefault();
                    loadCard(input.value);
                }
            }
        );

        document
            .getElementById("printButton")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {
                    window.print();
                }
            );

        document
            .getElementById("pdfButton")
            .addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {
                    window.print();
                }
            );
    }

    function setupFooter() {
        document.getElementById(
            "footerYear"
        ).textContent =
            new Date().getFullYear();
    }

    setupDate();
    setupFooter();
    setupFontControls();
    setupButtons();
    initializeInput();

})();
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsSearchForm"
            );

        const district =
            document.getElementById(
                "districtSelect"
            );

        const locality =
            document.getElementById(
                "localityInput"
            );

        const button =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsSearchButton"
            );

        const message =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsMessage"
            );

        const loading =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsLoading"
            );

        const empty =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsEmpty"
            );

        const results =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsResults"
            );

        const grid =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsGrid"
            );

        const count =
            document.getElementById(
                "fpsCount"
            );


        function escapeHtml(
            value
        ) {

            if (
                value === null ||
                value === undefined
            ) {
                return "";
            }

            return String(value)
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&amp;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /</g,
                    "&lt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    />/g,
                    "&gt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    "&quot;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /'/g,
                    "&#039;"
                );

        }


        function showMessage(
            text,
            type
        ) {

            message.textContent =
                text;

            message.className =
                "fps-message show " +
                type;

        }


        function resetState() {

            empty.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );

            message.className =
                "fps-message";

            grid.innerHTML =
                "";

        }


        function getArray(
            data
        ) {

            if (
                Array.isArray(data)
            ) {
                return data;
            }

            if (
                data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    data.content
                )
            ) {
                return data.content;
            }

            if (
                data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    data.shops
                )
            ) {
                return data.shops;
            }

            if (
                data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    data.fairPriceShops
                )
            ) {
                return data.fairPriceShops;
            }

            if (
                data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    data.data
                )
            ) {
                return data.data;
            }

            if (
                data &&
                data.data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    data.data.content
                )
            ) {
                return data.data.content;
            }

            return [];

        }


        function normalizeShop(
            shop
        ) {

            return {

                name:
                    shop.name ||
                    shop.shopName ||
                    shop.fpsName ||
                    shop.fairPriceShopName ||
                    "Fair Price Shop",

                code:
                    shop.code ||
                    shop.shopCode ||
                    shop.fpsId ||
                    shop.id ||
                    "â€”",

                address:
                    shop.address ||
                    shop.location ||
                    shop.fullAddress ||
                    "Address not available",

                district:
                    shop.district ||
                    "â€”",

                dealer:
                    shop.dealerName ||
                    shop.ownerName ||
                    shop.dealer ||
                    "â€”",

                phone:
                    shop.phone ||
                    shop.mobile ||
                    shop.contactNumber ||
                    "â€”",

                status:
                    shop.status ||
                    "ACTIVE"

            };

        }


        function renderShops(
            shops
        ) {

            grid.innerHTML =
                "";

            count.textContent =
                shops.length +
                (
                    shops.length === 1
                        ? " shop"
                        : " shops"
                );


            if (
                shops.length === 0
            ) {

                empty.classList.add(
                    "show"
                );

                return;

            }


            shops.forEach(
                function (
                    rawShop
                ) {

                    const shop =
                        normalizeShop(
                            rawShop
                        );


                    const card =
                        document.createElement(
                            "article"
                        );

                    card.className =
                        "fps-shop";


                    card.innerHTML =
                        `
                        <div class="fps-shop-top">

                            <div class="fps-shop-icon">
                                â–£
                            </div>

                            <div class="fps-shop-name">

                                <h3>
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.name)}
                                </h3>

                                <p>
                                    FPS Code:
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.code)}
                                </p>

                            </div>

                            <span class="fps-open">
                                ${escapeHtml(
                                    String(shop.status)
                                        .toUpperCase()
                                )}
                            </span>

                        </div>


                        <div class="fps-shop-details">

                            <div class="fps-detail">

                                <div class="fps-detail-label">
                                    District
                                </div>

                                <div class="fps-detail-value">
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.district)}
                                </div>

                            </div>


                            <div class="fps-detail">

                                <div class="fps-detail-label">
                                    Dealer
                                </div>

                                <div class="fps-detail-value">
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.dealer)}
                                </div>

                            </div>


                            <div class="fps-detail">

                                <div class="fps-detail-label">
                                    Address
                                </div>

                                <div class="fps-detail-value">
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.address)}
                                </div>

                            </div>


                            <div class="fps-detail">

                                <div class="fps-detail-label">
                                    Contact
                                </div>

                                <div class="fps-detail-value">
                                    ${escapeHtml(shop.phone)}
                                </div>

                            </div>

                        </div>


                        <div class="fps-shop-actions">

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                class="primary"
                                data-address="${escapeHtml(shop.address)}"
                            >
                                View Address
                            </button>

                            <button
                                type="button"
                                data-phone="${escapeHtml(shop.phone)}"
                            >
                                Contact
                            </button>

                        </div>
                        `;


                    const addressButton =
                        card.querySelector(
                            "button.primary"
                        );


                    const contactButton =
                        card.querySelector(
                            "button:not(.primary)"
                        );


                    addressButton.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            const address =
                                this.getAttribute(
                                    "data-address"
                                );


                            if (
                                address &&
                                address !==
                                    "Address not available"
                            ) {

                                showMessage(
                                    "Shop address: " +
                                    address,
                                    "success"
                                );

                            }
                            else {

                                showMessage(
                                    "Address information is not available.",
                                    "error"
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );


                    contactButton.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {

                            const phone =
                                this.getAttribute(
                                    "data-phone"
                                );


                            if (
                                phone &&
                                phone !== "â€”"
                            ) {

                                showMessage(
                                    "Shop contact number: " +
                                    phone,
                                    "success"
                                );

                            }
                            else {

                                showMessage(
                                    "Contact information is not available.",
                                    "error"
                                );

                            }

                        }
                    );


                    grid.appendChild(
                        card
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        function filterLocalResults(
            shops
        ) {

            const selectedDistrict =
                district.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();

            const searchText =
                locality.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();


            if (
                !selectedDistrict &&
                !searchText
            ) {

                return shops;

            }


            return shops.filter(
                function (
                    rawShop
                ) {

                    const shop =
                        normalizeShop(
                            rawShop
                        );


                    const combined =
                        (
                            shop.name +
                            " " +
                            shop.code +
                            " " +
                            shop.address +
                            " " +
                            shop.district +
                            " " +
                            shop.dealer
                        )
                            .toLowerCase();


                    const districtMatch =
                        !selectedDistrict ||
                        shop.district
                            .toLowerCase()
                            .includes(
                                selectedDistrict
                            );


                    const textMatch =
                        !searchText ||
                        combined.includes(
                            searchText
                        );


                    return (
                        districtMatch &&
                        textMatch
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        async function searchShops() {

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return;

            }


            resetState();


            loading.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

            button.disabled =
                true;

            button.textContent =
                "Searching...";


            try {

                const apiBase =
                    window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                    "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                /*
                 * The backend route for Fair Price
                 * Shops is not guaranteed by the
                 * current SecurityConfig.
                 *
                 * Therefore this page attempts the
                 * endpoint when available and falls
                 * back gracefully if the route does
                 * not exist.
                 */
                const queryParts = [];


                if (
                    district.value.trim()
                ) {

                    queryParts.push(
                        "district=" +
                        encodeURIComponent(
                            district.value.trim()
                        )
                    );

                }


                if (
                    locality.value.trim()
                ) {

                    queryParts.push(
                        "search=" +
                        encodeURIComponent(
                            locality.value.trim()
                        )
                    );

                }


                const query =
                    queryParts.length
                        ? "?" +
                          queryParts.join("&")
                        : "";


                const response =
                    await fetch(
                        apiBase +
                        "/fair-price-shops" +
                        query,
                        {
                            method: "GET",

                            headers: {
                                "Authorization":
                                    "Bearer " +
                                    token,

                                "Accept":
                                    "application/json"
                            }
                        }
                    );


                if (
                    response.status === 401
                ) {

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalToken"
                    );

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    );

                    window.location.href =
                        "login.html";

                    return;

                }


                let data = null;


                try {

                    data =
                        await response.json();

                }
                catch (
                    jsonError
                ) {

                    data = null;

                }


                if (
                    !response.ok
                ) {

                    if (
                        response.status === 404
                    ) {

                        throw new Error(
                            "Fair Price Shop service is not available on the current backend."
                        );

                    }


                    throw new Error(
                        data &&
                        (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                            ? (
                                data.message ||
                                data.error
                            )
                            : "Unable to retrieve Fair Price Shops."
                    );

                }


                const shops =
                    filterLocalResults(
                        getArray(data)
                    );


                renderShops(
                    shops
                );


                showMessage(
                    shops.length +
                    (
                        shops.length === 1
                            ? " Fair Price Shop found."
                            : " Fair Price Shops found."
                    ),
                    "success"
                );

            }
            catch (
                error
            ) {

                console.error(
                    "Fair Price Shop error:",
                    error
                );


                grid.innerHTML =
                    "";


                count.textContent =
                    "0 shops";


                showMessage(
                    error.message ||
                    "Unable to retrieve Fair Price Shops.",
                    "error"
                );

            }
            finally {

                loading.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

                button.disabled =
                    false;

                button.textContent =
                    "Search Shops";

            }

        }


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (
                event
            ) {

                event.preventDefault();

                searchShops();

            }
        );


        /*
         * Keep the page useful even when
         * the backend returns an empty
         * result set.
         */
        grid.innerHTML =
            `
            <article class="fps-shop">

                <div class="fps-shop-top">

                    <div class="fps-shop-icon">
                        â–£
                    </div>

                    <div class="fps-shop-name">

                        <h3>
                            Search for a Fair Price Shop
                        </h3>

                        <p>
                            Select a district or enter a locality
                            above to view available shops.
                        </p>

                    </div>

                </div>

                <div class="fps-shop-details">

                    <div class="fps-detail">

                        <div class="fps-detail-label">
                            Service
                        </div>

                        <div class="fps-detail-value">
                            Public Distribution System
                        </div>

                    </div>

                    <div class="fps-detail">

                        <div class="fps-detail-label">
                            Availability
                        </div>

                        <div class="fps-detail-value">
                            Search online
                        </div>

                    </div>

                </div>

            </article>
            `;


        count.textContent =
            "Search required";


        const year =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (year) {

            year.textContent =
                new Date()
                    .getFullYear();

        }

    }
);
</script>

</body>
</html>

    <script>
        "use strict";

        const API_BASE =
            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";

        function getToken() {
            return localStorage.getItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );
        }

        function authenticatedFetch(
            url,
            options = {}
        ) {
            const token = getToken();

            const headers = {
                ...(options.headers || {})
            };

            if (token) {
                headers.Authorization =
                    "Bearer " + token;
            }

            headers.Accept =
                "application/json";

            return fetch(url, {
                ...options,
                headers
            });
        }

        function getCurrentUser() {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(
                    localStorage.getItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    ) || "null"
                );
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function firstValue(
            object,
            keys,
            fallback = null
        ) {
            if (!object) {
                return fallback;
            }

            for (const key of keys) {
                if (
                    object[key] !== undefined &&
                    object[key] !== null &&
                    object[key] !== ""
                ) {
                    return object[key];
                }
            }

            return fallback;
        }

        function normalizeMembers(
            response
        ) {
            if (Array.isArray(response)) {
                return response;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.familyMembers
                )
            ) {
                return response.familyMembers;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.members
                )
            ) {
                return response.members;
            }

            if (
                response &&
                response.data
            ) {
                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data;
                }

                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data.familyMembers
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data.familyMembers;
                }

                if (
                    Array.isArray(
                        response.data.members
                    )
                ) {
                    return response.data.members;
                }
            }

            return [];
        }

        function calculateCategory(
            age
        ) {
            const numericAge =
                Number(age);

            if (
                Number.isFinite(
                    numericAge
                ) &&
                numericAge >= 18
            ) {
                return "Adult";
            }

            return "Child";
        }

        function getMemberName(
            member
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                member,
                [
                    "name",
                    "memberName",
                    "member_name",
                    "fullName",
                    "full_name"
                ],
                "Unnamed Member"
            );
        }

        function getAge(
            member
        ) {
            return Number(
                firstValue(
                    member,
                    [
                        "age",
                        "memberAge",
                        "member_age"
                    ],
                    0
                )
            ) || 0;
        }

        function getGender(
            member
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                member,
                [
                    "gender",
                    "sex"
                ],
                "â€”"
            );
        }

        function getRelationship(
            member
        ) {
            return firstValue(
                member,
                [
                    "relationship",
                    "relation",
                    "relationType",
                    "relation_type"
                ],
                "â€”"
            );
        }

        function getQuota(
            member
        ) {
            return Number(
                firstValue(
                    member,
                    [
                        "riceQuota",
                        "rice_quota",
                        "monthlyRiceQuota",
                        "monthly_rice_quota",
                        "quota"
                    ],
                    0
                )
            ) || 0;
        }

        function showError(
            message
        ) {
            document.getElementById(
                "loadingBox"
            ).style.display =
                "none";

            const errorBox =
                document.getElementById(
                    "errorBox"
                );

            errorBox.textContent =
                message;

            errorBox.style.display =
                "block";
        }

        function renderMembers(
            members
        ) {
            const body =
                document.getElementById(
                    "familyTableBody"
                );

            body.innerHTML = "";

            if (
                !members ||
                members.length === 0
            ) {
                document.getElementById(
                    "loadingBox"
                ).style.display =
                    "none";

                document.getElementById(
                    "emptyState"
                ).style.display =
                    "block";

                return;
            }

            const enriched =
                members.map(
                    function (member) {

                        const age =
                            getAge(member);

                        return {
                            raw: member,
                            name:
                                getMemberName(
                                    member
                                ),
                            age,
                            gender:
                                getGender(
                                    member
                                ),
                            relationship:
                                getRelationship(
                                    member
                                ),
                            category:
                                calculateCategory(
                                    age
                                ),
                            quota:
                                getQuota(
                                    member
                                )
                        };
                    }
                );

            const sorted =
                [...enriched].sort(
                    function (a, b) {
                        return (
                            b.age -
                            a.age
                        );
                    }
                );

            const eldest =
                sorted.length > 0
                    ? sorted[0]
                    : null;

            const youngest =
                sorted.length > 0
                    ? sorted[
                        sorted.length - 1
                    ]
                    : null;

            let adults = 0;
            let children = 0;
            let totalRice = 0;

            enriched.forEach(
                function (member) {

                    if (
                        member.category ===
                        "Adult"
                    ) {
                        adults++;
                    } else {
                        children++;
                    }

                    totalRice +=
                        member.quota;
                }
            );

            document.getElementById(
                "totalMembers"
            ).textContent =
                enriched.length;

            document.getElementById(
                "adultMembers"
            ).textContent =
                adults;

            document.getElementById(
                "childMembers"
            ).textContent =
                children;

            document.getElementById(
                "totalRice"
            ).textContent =
                totalRice;

            enriched.forEach(
                function (member) {

                    const row =
                        document.createElement(
                            "tr"
                        );

                    const isEldest =
                        eldest &&
                        member.raw ===
                            eldest.raw;

                    const isYoungest =
                        youngest &&
                        member.raw ===
                            youngest.raw;

                    let marker = "";

                    if (isEldest) {
                        marker +=
                            '<span class="special-mark">ELDEST</span>';
                    }

                    if (
                        isYoungest &&
                        youngest !== eldest
                    ) {
                        marker +=
                            '<span class="special-mark">YOUNGEST</span>';
                    }

                    const categoryClass =
                        member.category ===
                        "Adult"
                            ? "adult-pill"
                            : "child-pill";

                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <td>
                            <span class="member-name">
                                ${escapeHtml(member.name)}
                            </span>
                            ${marker}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${member.age}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${escapeHtml(member.gender)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="relationship-pill">
                                ${escapeHtml(member.relationship)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="category-pill ${categoryClass}">
                                ${member.category}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="quota">
                                ${member.quota}
                            </span>
                        </td>
                    `;

                    body.appendChild(
                        row
                    );
                }
            );

            document.getElementById(
                "loadingBox"
            ).style.display =
                "none";

            document.getElementById(
                "tableWrapper"
            ).style.display =
                "block";
        }

        function escapeHtml(
            value
        ) {
            return String(value)
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&amp;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /</g,
                    "&lt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    />/g,
                    "&gt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    "&quot;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /'/g,
                    "&#039;"
                );
        }

        async function loadFamily() {

            const user =
                getCurrentUser();

            const rationCardNumber =
                firstValue(
                    user,
                    [
                        "rationCardNumber",
                        "ration_card_number",
                        "cardNumber",
                        "rationId",
                        "ration_id"
                    ]
                );

            const memberId =
                firstValue(
                    user,
                    [
                        "memberId",
                        "member_id"
                    ]
                );

            let endpoint = null;

            /*
             * Prefer the ration-card family endpoint.
             */
            if (
                rationCardNumber
            ) {
                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/family-members/ration-card/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        rationCardNumber
                    );
            } else if (
                memberId
            ) {
                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/family-members/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        memberId
                    );
            } else {
                showError(
                    "Your account does not currently contain a ration card or member identifier. Please contact the administrator."
                );

                return;
            }

            try {

                const response =
                    await authenticatedFetch(
                        endpoint
                    );

                if (
                    response.status === 401 ||
                    response.status === 403
                ) {
                    if (
                        window.authGuard &&
                        typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                            "function"
                    ) {
                        window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                    }

                    return;
                }

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Unable to load family information."
                    );
                }

                const data =
                    await response.json();

                const members =
                    normalizeMembers(
                        data
                    );

                renderMembers(
                    members
                );

            } catch (error) {

                console.error(
                    "Family loading error:",
                    error
                );

                showError(
                    "Family details could not be loaded from the server yet. Please make sure family members are registered in the system."
                );
            }
        }

        function updateDate() {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    "currentDate"
                );

            const now =
                new Date();

            element.textContent =
                now.toLocaleDateString(
                    "en-IN",
                    {
                        weekday: "short",
                        day: "2-digit",
                        month: "short",
                        year: "numeric"
                    }
                );
        }

        function logoutCitizen() {

            if (
                window.authGuard &&
                typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                    "function"
            ) {
                window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                return;
            }

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalUser"
            );

            window.location.href =
                "login.html";
        }

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {

                updateDate();

                loadFamily();

            }
        );
    </script>

</body>
</html>
