<script>

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "forgotPasswordForm"
            );


        const emailInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "email"
            );


        const emailError =
            document.getElementById(
                "emailError"
            );


        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "forgotAlert"
            );


        const resetButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "resetButton"
            );


        function showError(
            message
        ) {

            emailError.textContent =
                message;

            emailError.style.display =
                "block";

        }


        function hideError() {

            emailError.textContent =
                "";

            emailError.style.display =
                "none";

        }


        function showAlert(
            message,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                message;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert alert-" + type;

            alertBox.style.display =
                "block";

        }


        function hideAlert() {

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

            alertBox.style.display =
                "none";

        }


        function validEmail(
            email
        ) {

            return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
                .test(email);

        }


        emailInput.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                hideError();

                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            async function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();

                hideError();

                hideAlert();


                const email =
                    emailInput.value
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();


                if (!email) {

                    showError(
                        "Please enter your email address."
                    );

                    return;

                }


                if (!validEmail(email)) {

                    showError(
                        "Please enter a valid email address."
                    );

                    return;

                }


                const originalText =
                    resetButton.textContent;


                resetButton.disabled =
                    true;


                resetButton.textContent =
                    "Sending...";


                /*
                 * The backend endpoint will be
                 * implemented in a later step.
                 *
                 * STEP 5 only creates the page
                 * and user interface.
                 */

                const apiBase =
                    window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                    "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                try {

                    const response =
                        await fetch(
                            apiBase +
                            "/auth/forgot-password",
                            {
                                method: "POST",

                                headers: {
                                    "Content-Type":
                                        "application/json",

                                    "Accept":
                                        "application/json"
                                },

                                body:
                                    JSON.stringify({
                                        email: email
                                    })
                            }
                        );


                    let data = null;


                    try {

                        data =
                            await response.json();

                    }
                    catch (error) {

                        data = null;

                    }


                    if (!response.ok) {

                        throw new Error(
                            data &&
                            data.message
                                ? data.message
                                : "Unable to process the password reset request."
                        );

                    }


                    showAlert(
                        data &&
                        data.message
                            ? data.message
                            : "If an account exists for this email, a password reset link has been sent.",
                        "success"
                    );


                    emailInput.value =
                        "";

                }
                catch (error) {

                    console.error(
                        "Forgot password error:",
                        error
                    );


                    showAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Unable to connect to the password recovery service.",
                        "danger"
                    );

                }
                finally {

                    resetButton.disabled =
                        false;

                    resetButton.textContent =
                        originalText;

                }

            }
        );


        const currentYear =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );


        if (currentYear) {

            currentYear.textContent =
                new Date().getFullYear();

        }

    }
);

</script>

<script id="RationPortalForgotPasswordTimeout">
(function () {
    const originalFetch = window.fetch;

    window.fetch = function (input, init) {
        const url = typeof input === "string" ? input : (input && input.url) || "";

        if (!url.includes("/api/auth/forgot-password")) {
            return originalFetch.apply(this, arguments);
        }

        const controller = new AbortController();
        const originalSignal = init && init.signal;

        if (originalSignal) {
            if (originalSignal.aborted) {
                controller.abort();
            } else {
                originalSignal.addEventListener("abort", function () {
                    controller.abort();
                }, { once: true });
            }
        }

        const timeoutId = setTimeout(function () {
            controller.abort();
        }, 90000);

        const requestInit = Object.assign({}, init || {}, {
            signal: controller.signal
        });

        return originalFetch.call(this, input, requestInit)
            .catch(function (error) {
                if (error && error.name === "AbortError") {
                    throw new Error("Request timed out. Please try again.");
                }
                throw error;
            })
            .finally(function () {
                clearTimeout(timeoutId);
            });
    };
})();
</script></body>

<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "grievanceForm"
            );

        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "formAlert"
            );

        const submitButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "submitButton"
            );

        const description =
            document.getElementById(
                "description"
            );

        const characterCount =
            document.getElementById(
                "characterCount"
            );

        const referenceBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "grievanceReference"
            );

        const referenceNumber =
            document.getElementById(
                "referenceNumber"
            );


        function showAlert(
            text,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                text;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert-box show " +
                type;

            window.scrollTo({
                top:
                    Math.max(
                        0,
                        form.offsetTop - 80
                    ),
                behavior:
                    "smooth"
            });

        }


        function clearAlert() {

            alertBox.className =
                "alert-box";

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

        }


        function updateCharacterCount() {

            characterCount.textContent =
                description.value.length +
                " / 2000";

        }


        function getInput(
            id
        ) {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    id
                );

            return element
                ? element.value.trim()
                : "";

        }


        async function submitGrievance(
            payload
        ) {

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return;

            }


            const apiBase =
                window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


            /*
             * This endpoint is confirmed by the
             * current backend SecurityConfig:
             *
             * POST /api/grievances
             */
            const response =
                await fetch(
                    apiBase +
                    "/grievances",
                    {
                        method: "POST",

                        headers: {
                            "Authorization":
                                "Bearer " +
                                token,

                            "Content-Type":
                                "application/json",

                            "Accept":
                                "application/json"
                        },

                        body:
                            JSON.stringify(
                                payload
                            )
                    }
                );


            if (
                response.status === 401
            ) {

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalUser"
                );

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return null;

            }


            let data = null;


            try {

                data =
                    await response.json();

            }
            catch (
                jsonError
            ) {

                data = null;

            }


            if (!response.ok) {

                throw new Error(
                    data &&
                    (
                        data.message ||
                        data.error
                    )
                        ? (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                        : "Unable to submit grievance."
                );

            }


            return data;

        }


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            async function (
                event
            ) {

                event.preventDefault();


                clearAlert();


                if (
                    !form.checkValidity()
                ) {

                    form.reportValidity();

                    return;

                }


                const mobile =
                    getInput(
                        "mobileNumber"
                    );


                if (
                    !/^[0-9]{10}$/.test(
                        mobile
                    )
                ) {

                    showAlert(
                        "Please enter a valid 10-digit mobile number.",
                        "error"
                    );

                    return;

                }


                const payload = { applicantName: getInput("citizenName"), contactNumber: mobile, rationCardNumber: getInput("rationNumber"), category: getInput("category"), description: getInput("description") };


                submitButton.disabled =
                    true;

                submitButton.textContent =
                    "Submitting...";


                try {

                    const response =
                        await submitGrievance(
                            payload
                        );


                    if (
                        response === null
                    ) {

                        return;

                    }


                    const finalReference = response && response.grievanceNumber; if (!finalReference) { throw new Error("Grievance was submitted, but the server did not return a grievance number."); }


                    referenceNumber.textContent =
                        finalReference;


                    referenceBox.classList.add(
                        "show"
                    );


                    showAlert(
                        "Your grievance has been submitted successfully.",
                        "success"
                    );


                    form.querySelectorAll(
                        "input, select, textarea, button"
                    ).forEach(
                        function (
                            element
                        ) {

                            if (
                                element.type !==
                                "button"
                            ) {

                                element.disabled =
                                    true;

                            }

                        }
                    );


                    submitButton.textContent =
                        "Submitted";


                }
                catch (
                    error
                ) {

                    console.error(
                        "Grievance submission error:",
                        error
                    );


                    showAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Unable to submit grievance. Please try again.",
                        "error"
                    );


                    submitButton.disabled =
                        false;

                    submitButton.textContent =
                        "Submit Grievance";

                }

            }
        );


        description.addEventListener(
            "input",
            updateCharacterCount
        );


        updateCharacterCount();


        const year =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (year) {

            year.textContent =
                new Date()
                    .getFullYear();

        }

    }
);
</script>

<style id="grievanceSubmissionTimer">
.grievance-submit-status{margin-top:10px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:8px;background:#eef6ff;border:1px solid #c8def5;color:#15558a;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;text-align:center;display:none}.grievance-submit-status.active{display:block}.grievance-submit-status.expired{background:#fff8e8;border-color:#f1d48a;color:#805b00}
</style>
<script id="grievanceSubmissionTimer">
(function(){
"use strict";
var form=document.querySelector("form");
if(!form)return;
var button=form.querySelector('button[type="submit"],input[type="submit"]');
if(!button)return;
var timer=null,startTime=0,duration=60000,statusBox=null,originalText=button.textContent||button.value||"Submit Grievance";
function ensureStatus(){
 if(statusBox)return statusBox;
 statusBox=document.createElement("div");
 statusBox.className="grievance-submit-status";
 statusBox.setAttribute("aria-live","polite");
 statusBox.setAttribute("role","status");
 button.parentNode.insertBefore(statusBox,button.nextSibling);
 return statusBox;
}
function setButtonText(value){
 if(button.tagName==="INPUT")button.value=value;else button.textContent=value;
}
function stopTimer(){
 if(timer){clearInterval(timer);timer=null;}
}
function finish(message,expired){
 stopTimer();
 if(statusBox){
  statusBox.textContent=message;
  statusBox.classList.toggle("expired",!!expired);
  statusBox.classList.add("active");
 }
}
function watchPage(){
 var text=(document.body.innerText||"").toLowerCase();
 if(text.indexOf("grievance has been submitted successfully")>=0 || text.indexOf("grievance reference number")>=0){
  finish("Grievance submitted successfully. Your reference number is shown below.",false);
  return true;
 }
 if(text.indexOf("failed to submit")>=0 || text.indexOf("unable to submit")>=0 || text.indexOf("submission failed")>=0 || text.indexOf("error submitting")>=0){
  stopTimer();
  if(statusBox)statusBox.classList.remove("active");
  button.disabled=false;
  setButtonText(originalText);
  return true;
 }
 return false;
}
form.addEventListener("submit",function(){
 if(!form.checkValidity())return;
 var box=ensureStatus();
 stopTimer();
 startTime=Date.now();
 button.disabled=true;
 box.classList.add("active");
 box.classList.remove("expired");
 timer=setInterval(function(){
  if(watchPage())return;
  var elapsed=Date.now()-startTime;
  var remaining=Math.max(0,duration-elapsed);
  var seconds=Math.ceil(remaining/1000);
  var minutes=Math.floor(seconds/60);
  var secs=seconds%60;
  if(remaining>0){
   var display=minutes+":"+String(secs).padStart(2,"0");
   setButtonText("Submitting... "+display);
   box.textContent="Your grievance is being submitted securely. Please wait Ã¢â‚¬â€ this may take up to 1 minute. Time remaining: "+display;
  }else{
   finish("The submission is taking longer than expected. Please do not click Submit again. We are still waiting for the server response.",true);
   setButtonText("Still Processing...");
  }
 },250);
},false);
})();
</script></body>
</html>

<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const tableArea =
            document.getElementById(
                "tableArea"
            );

        const tableBody =
            document.getElementById(
                "grievanceTableBody"
            );

        const loadingState =
            document.getElementById(
                "loadingState"
            );

        const emptyState =
            document.getElementById(
                "emptyState"
            );

        const errorState =
            document.getElementById(
                "errorState"
            );

        const errorMessage =
            document.getElementById(
                "errorMessage"
            );

        const refreshButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "refreshButton"
            );

        const searchInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "searchInput"
            );

        const statusFilter =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusFilter"
            );

        const categoryFilter =
            document.getElementById(
                "categoryFilter"
            );

        const clearFilters =
            document.getElementById(
                "clearFilters"
            );


        let grievances = [];


        function getValue(
            object,
            keys,
            fallback
        ) {

            if (
                !object ||
                typeof object !== "object"
            ) {

                return fallback || "";

            }


            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < keys.length;
                i++
            ) {

                const value =
                    object[keys[i]];


                if (
                    value !== undefined &&
                    value !== null &&
                    String(value).trim() !== ""
                ) {

                    return value;

                }

            }


            return fallback || "";

        }


        function unwrapArray(
            response
        ) {

            if (
                Array.isArray(response)
            ) {

                return response;

            }


            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.content
                )
            ) {

                return response.content;

            }


            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.grievances
                )
            ) {

                return response.grievances;

            }


            if (
                response &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.data
                )
            ) {

                return response.data;

            }


            if (
                response &&
                response.data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.data.content
                )
            ) {

                return response.data.content;

            }


            if (
                response &&
                response.data &&
                Array.isArray(
                    response.data.grievances
                )
            ) {

                return response.data.grievances;

            }


            return [];

        }


        function normalizeStatus(
            value
        ) {

            const status =
                String(
                    value || "PENDING"
                )
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();


            if (
                status.includes("RESOLVED") ||
                status.includes("CLOSED") ||
                status.includes("COMPLETED")
            ) {

                return "RESOLVED";

            }


            if (
                status.includes("REJECT")
            ) {

                return "REJECTED";

            }


            if (
                status.includes("PROCESS") ||
                status.includes("REVIEW")
            ) {

                return "PROCESSING";

            }


            return "PENDING";

        }


        function statusLabel(
            status
        ) {

            const labels = {
                PENDING: "Pending",
                PROCESSING: "Processing",
                RESOLVED: "Resolved",
                REJECTED: "Rejected"
            };


            return (
                labels[status] ||
                "Pending"
            );

        }


        function statusClass(
            status
        ) {

            const classes = {
                PENDING: "pending",
                PROCESSING: "processing",
                RESOLVED: "resolved",
                REJECTED: "rejected"
            };


            return (
                classes[status] ||
                "pending"
            );

        }


        function formatDate(
            value
        ) {

            if (!value) {
                return "â€”";
            }


            const date =
                new Date(value);


            if (
                Number.isNaN(
                    date.getTime()
                )
            ) {

                return String(value);

            }


            return date.toLocaleDateString(
                "en-IN",
                {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric"
                }
            );

        }


        function escapeHtml(
            value
        ) {

            if (
                typeof window.escapeHtml ===
                "function"
            ) {

                return window.escapeHtml(
                    String(value || "")
                );

            }


            return String(
                value || ""
            )
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&amp;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /</g,
                    "&lt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    />/g,
                    "&gt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    "&quot;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /'/g,
                    "&#039;"
                );

        }


        function renderStats(
            records
        ) {

            let pending = 0;
            let processing = 0;
            let resolved = 0;


            records.forEach(
                function (
                    record
                ) {

                    const status =
                        normalizeStatus(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "status",
                                    "grievanceStatus",
                                    "state"
                                ],
                                "PENDING"
                            )
                        );


                    if (
                        status === "PENDING"
                    ) {

                        pending++;

                    }
                    else if (
                        status === "PROCESSING"
                    ) {

                        processing++;

                    }
                    else if (
                        status === "RESOLVED"
                    ) {

                        resolved++;

                    }

                }
            );


            document.getElementById(
                "totalCount"
            ).textContent =
                records.length;


            document.getElementById(
                "pendingCount"
            ).textContent =
                pending;


            document.getElementById(
                "processingCount"
            ).textContent =
                processing;


            document.getElementById(
                "resolvedCount"
            ).textContent =
                resolved;

        }


        function getFilteredRecords() {

            const search =
                searchInput.value
                    .trim()
                    .toLowerCase();


            const status =
                statusFilter.value;


            const category =
                categoryFilter.value;


            return grievances.filter(
                function (
                    record
                ) {

                    const reference =
                        String(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "grievanceNumber",
                                    "referenceNumber",
                                    "grievanceId",
                                    "number",
                                    "id"
                                ],
                                ""
                            )
                        ).toLowerCase();


                    const citizen =
                        String(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "name",
                                    "citizenName",
                                    "applicantName"
                                ],
                                ""
                            )
                        ).toLowerCase();


                    const subject =
                        String(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "subject",
                                    "title"
                                ],
                                ""
                            )
                        ).toLowerCase();


                    const recordStatus =
                        normalizeStatus(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "status",
                                    "grievanceStatus",
                                    "state"
                                ],
                                "PENDING"
                            )
                        );


                    const recordCategory =
                        String(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "category",
                                    "grievanceCategory",
                                    "type"
                                ],
                                ""
                            )
                        );


                    const searchMatch =
                        !search ||
                        reference.includes(
                            search
                        ) ||
                        citizen.includes(
                            search
                        ) ||
                        subject.includes(
                            search
                        );


                    const statusMatch =
                        !status ||
                        recordStatus ===
                            status;


                    const categoryMatch =
                        !category ||
                        recordCategory
                            .toLowerCase() ===
                            category.toLowerCase();


                    return (
                        searchMatch &&
                        statusMatch &&
                        categoryMatch
                    );

                }
            );

        }


        function renderTable() {

            const records =
                getFilteredRecords();


            tableBody.innerHTML =
                "";


            if (
                records.length === 0
            ) {

                tableArea.style.display =
                    "none";

                emptyState.style.display =
                    "block";

                return;

            }


            emptyState.style.display =
                "none";

            tableArea.style.display =
                "block";


            records.forEach(
                function (
                    record
                ) {

                    const reference =
                        getValue(
                            record,
                            [
                                "grievanceNumber",
                                "referenceNumber",
                                "grievanceId",
                                "number",
                                "id"
                            ],
                            "â€”"
                        );


                    const citizen =
                        getValue(
                            record,
                            [
                                "name",
                                "citizenName",
                                "applicantName"
                            ],
                            "â€”"
                        );


                    const category =
                        getValue(
                            record,
                            [
                                "category",
                                "grievanceCategory",
                                "type"
                            ],
                            "â€”"
                        );


                    const subject =
                        getValue(
                            record,
                            [
                                "subject",
                                "title"
                            ],
                            "â€”"
                        );


                    const district =
                        getValue(
                            record,
                            [
                                "district",
                                "location"
                            ],
                            "â€”"
                        );


                    const priority =
                        String(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "priority",
                                    "urgency"
                                ],
                                "NORMAL"
                            )
                        ).toUpperCase();


                    const status =
                        normalizeStatus(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "status",
                                    "grievanceStatus",
                                    "state"
                                ],
                                "PENDING"
                            )
                        );


                    const date =
                        formatDate(
                            getValue(
                                record,
                                [
                                    "createdAt",
                                    "submittedAt",
                                    "createdDate",
                                    "submissionDate"
                                ],
                                ""
                            )
                        );


                    const row =
                        document.createElement(
                            "tr"
                        );


                    row.innerHTML = `
                        <td>
                            <span class="reference">
                                ${escapeHtml(reference)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="citizen-name">
                                ${escapeHtml(citizen)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${escapeHtml(category)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <div class="subject-cell">
                                ${escapeHtml(subject)}
                            </div>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${escapeHtml(district)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="priority-badge ${
                                priority === "HIGH"
                                    ? "high"
                                    : ""
                            }">
                                ${escapeHtml(priority)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <span class="status-badge ${statusClass(status)}">
                                ${statusLabel(status)}
                            </span>
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            ${escapeHtml(date)}
                        </td>

                        <td>
                            <button
                                type="button"
                                class="row-action"
                                data-reference="${escapeHtml(reference)}"
                            >
                                View
                            </button>
                        </td>
                    `;


                    tableBody.appendChild(
                        row
                    );

                }
            );


            tableBody
                .querySelectorAll(
                    ".row-action"
                )
                .forEach(
                    function (
                        button
                    ) {

                        button.addEventListener(
                            "click",
                            function () {

                                const reference =
                                    button.dataset.reference;


                                if (
                                    reference &&
                                    reference !== "â€”"
                                ) {

                                    window.location.href =
                                        "grievance-status.html?grievance=" +
                                        encodeURIComponent(
                                            reference
                                        );

                                }

                            }
                        );

                    }
                );

        }


        async function loadGrievances() {

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return;

            }


            const apiBase =
                window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


            loadingState.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

            errorState.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );

            emptyState.style.display =
                "none";

            tableArea.style.display =
                "none";


            refreshButton.disabled =
                true;


            try {

                /*
                 * Confirmed backend route:
                 *
                 * GET /api/grievances
                 *
                 * This route is ADMIN-only in the
                 * current backend SecurityConfig.
                 */
                const response =
                    await fetch(
                        apiBase +
                        "/grievances",
                        {
                            method: "GET",

                            headers: {
                                "Authorization":
                                    "Bearer " +
                                    token,

                                "Accept":
                                    "application/json"
                            }
                        }
                    );


                if (
                    response.status === 401
                ) {

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalToken"
                    );

                    localStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    );

                    window.location.href =
                        "login.html";

                    return;

                }


                if (
                    response.status === 403
                ) {

                    throw new Error(
                        "Administrator access is required to view the grievance dashboard."
                    );

                }


                let data = null;


                try {

                    data =
                        await response.json();

                }
                catch (
                    jsonError
                ) {

                    data = null;

                }


                if (!response.ok) {

                    throw new Error(
                        data &&
                        (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                            ? (
                                data.message ||
                                data.error
                            )
                            : "Unable to load grievance records."
                    );

                }


                grievances =
                    unwrapArray(
                        data
                    );


                renderStats(
                    grievances
                );

                renderTable();

            }
            catch (
                error
            ) {

                console.error(
                    "Grievance dashboard error:",
                    error
                );


                errorMessage.textContent =
                    error.message ||
                    "Unable to load grievance records.";


                errorState.classList.add(
                    "show"
                );

            }
            finally {

                loadingState.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

                refreshButton.disabled =
                    false;

            }

        }


        function applyFilters() {

            renderTable();

        }


        searchInput.addEventListener(
            "input",
            applyFilters
        );


        statusFilter.addEventListener(
            "change",
            applyFilters
        );


        categoryFilter.addEventListener(
            "change",
            applyFilters
        );


        clearFilters.addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                searchInput.value =
                    "";

                statusFilter.value =
                    "";

                categoryFilter.value =
                    "";

                renderTable();

            }
        );


        refreshButton.addEventListener(
            "click",
            loadGrievances
        );


        const year =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (year) {

            year.textContent =
                new Date()
                    .getFullYear();

        }


        loadGrievances();

    }
);
</script>

</body>
</html>

<script>
document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusSearchForm"
            );

        const input =
            document.getElementById(
                "grievanceNumber"
            );

        const searchButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "searchButton"
            );

        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "alertBox"
            );

        const resultArea =
            document.getElementById(
                "resultArea"
            );

        const emptyState =
            document.getElementById(
                "emptyState"
            );

        const loadingState =
            document.getElementById(
                "loadingState"
            );

        const statusBadge =
            document.getElementById(
                "statusBadge"
            );

        const timeline =
            document.getElementById(
                "timeline"
            );


        function showAlert(
            message,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                message;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert-box show " +
                type;

        }


        function clearAlert() {

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

            alertBox.className =
                "alert-box";

        }


        function unwrapResponse(
            response
        ) {

            if (!response) {
                return {};
            }


            if (
                response.data &&
                typeof response.data === "object"
            ) {

                return response.data;

            }


            return response;

        }


        function getValue(
            object,
            keys,
            fallback
        ) {

            if (
                !object ||
                typeof object !== "object"
            ) {

                return fallback || "";

            }


            for (
                let i = 0;
                i < keys.length;
                i++
            ) {

                const value =
                    object[keys[i]];


                if (
                    value !== undefined &&
                    value !== null &&
                    String(value).trim() !== ""
                ) {

                    return value;

                }

            }


            return fallback || "";

        }


        function formatDate(
            value
        ) {

            if (!value) {
                return "â€”";
            }


            const date =
                new Date(value);


            if (
                Number.isNaN(
                    date.getTime()
                )
            ) {

                return String(value);

            }


            return date.toLocaleDateString(
                "en-IN",
                {
                    day: "2-digit",
                    month: "short",
                    year: "numeric"
                }
            );

        }


        function normalizeStatus(
            value
        ) {

            const status =
                String(
                    value || "PENDING"
                )
                    .trim()
                    .toUpperCase();


            if (
                status.includes("RESOLVED") ||
                status.includes("CLOSED") ||
                status.includes("COMPLETED")
            ) {

                return "RESOLVED";

            }


            if (
                status.includes("REJECT")
            ) {

                return "REJECTED";

            }


            if (
                status.includes("PROCESS") ||
                status.includes("REVIEW")
            ) {

                return "PROCESSING";

            }


            return "PENDING";

        }


        function statusLabel(
            status
        ) {

            const labels = {
                PENDING: "Pending",
                PROCESSING: "Processing",
                RESOLVED: "Resolved",
                REJECTED: "Rejected"
            };


            return (
                labels[status] ||
                "Pending"
            );

        }


        function statusClass(
            status
        ) {

            const classes = {
                PENDING: "pending",
                PROCESSING: "processing",
                RESOLVED: "resolved",
                REJECTED: "rejected"
            };


            return (
                classes[status] ||
                "pending"
            );

        }


        function escapeHtml(
            value
        ) {

            if (
                typeof window.escapeHtml ===
                "function"
            ) {

                return window.escapeHtml(
                    String(value || "")
                );

            }


            return String(
                value || ""
            )
                .replace(
                    /&/g,
                    "&amp;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /</g,
                    "&lt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    />/g,
                    "&gt;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /"/g,
                    "&quot;"
                )
                .replace(
                    /'/g,
                    "&#039;"
                );

        }


        function createTimeline(
            data,
            status
        ) {

            const submitted =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "createdAt",
                        "submittedAt",
                        "createdDate",
                        "submissionDate"
                    ],
                    ""
                );


            const updated =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "updatedAt",
                        "resolvedAt",
                        "closedAt",
                        "lastUpdated"
                    ],
                    ""
                );


            const items = [
                {
                    title:
                        "Grievance Submitted",
                    description:
                        submitted
                            ? "Grievance received on " +
                              formatDate(submitted) +
                              "."
                            : "Grievance has been received.",
                    active: true,
                    completed: true
                },
                {
                    title:
                        "Under Review",
                    description:
                        status === "PENDING"
                            ? "Your grievance is awaiting review."
                            : "The concerned department has reviewed the grievance.",
                    active:
                        status === "PROCESSING" ||
                        status === "RESOLVED" ||
                        status === "REJECTED",
                    completed:
                        status === "RESOLVED" ||
                        status === "REJECTED"
                },
                {
                    title:
                        status === "REJECTED"
                            ? "Grievance Closed"
                            : "Resolution",
                    description:
                        status === "RESOLVED"
                            ? (
                                updated
                                    ? "Grievance resolved on " +
                                      formatDate(updated) +
                                      "."
                                    : "Grievance has been resolved."
                              )
                            : status === "REJECTED"
                                ? (
                                    updated
                                        ? "Grievance closed on " +
                                          formatDate(updated) +
                                          "."
                                        : "Grievance has been closed."
                                  )
                                : "Final action will be recorded after review.",
                    active:
                        status === "RESOLVED" ||
                        status === "REJECTED",
                    completed:
                        status === "RESOLVED" ||
                        status === "REJECTED",
                    rejected:
                        status === "REJECTED"
                }
            ];


            timeline.innerHTML =
                items
                    .map(
                        function (
                            item
                        ) {

                            let className =
                                "timeline-item";

                            if (
                                item.completed
                            ) {

                                className +=
                                    " completed";

                            }
                            else if (
                                item.active
                            ) {

                                className +=
                                    " active";

                            }

                            if (
                                item.rejected
                            ) {

                                className +=
                                    " rejected";

                            }


                            return `
                                <li class="${className}">
                                    <div class="timeline-dot"></div>

                                    <div class="timeline-content">
                                        <h4>
                                            ${escapeHtml(item.title)}
                                        </h4>

                                        <p>
                                            ${escapeHtml(item.description)}
                                        </p>
                                    </div>
                                </li>
                            `;

                        }
                    )
                    .join("");

        }


        function displayResult(
            rawData
        ) {

            const data =
                unwrapResponse(
                    rawData
                );


            const status =
                normalizeStatus(
                    getValue(
                        data,
                        [
                            "status",
                            "grievanceStatus",
                            "state"
                        ],
                        "PENDING"
                    )
                );


            const number =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "grievanceNumber",
                        "referenceNumber",
                        "grievanceId",
                        "number",
                        "id"
                    ],
                    input.value.trim()
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "resultReference"
            ).textContent =
                "Reference: " +
                number;


            document.getElementById(
                "detailName"
            ).textContent =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "name",
                        "citizenName",
                        "applicantName"
                    ],
                    "â€”"
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "detailCategory"
            ).textContent =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "category",
                        "grievanceCategory",
                        "type"
                    ],
                    "â€”"
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "detailDistrict"
            ).textContent =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "district",
                        "location"
                    ],
                    "â€”"
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "detailSubmitted"
            ).textContent =
                formatDate(
                    getValue(
                        data,
                        [
                            "createdAt",
                            "submittedAt",
                            "createdDate",
                            "submissionDate"
                        ],
                        ""
                    )
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "detailSubject"
            ).textContent =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "subject",
                        "title"
                    ],
                    "â€”"
                );


            document.getElementById(
                "detailPriority"
            ).textContent =
                getValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "priority",
                        "urgency"
                    ],
                    "Normal"
                );


            statusBadge.textContent =
                statusLabel(
                    status
                );

            statusBadge.className =
                "status-badge " +
                statusClass(
                    status
                );


            createTimeline(
                data,
                status
            );


            resultArea.classList.add(
                "show"
            );

            emptyState.style.display =
                "none";

        }


        async function searchGrievance(
            number
        ) {

            const token =
                localStorage.getItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );


            if (!token) {

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return;

            }


            const apiBase =
                window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


            /*
             * Confirmed backend route:
             *
             * GET /api/grievances/{number}
             */
            const response =
                await fetch(
                    apiBase +
                    "/grievances/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        number
                    ),
                    {
                        method: "GET",

                        headers: {
                            "Authorization":
                                "Bearer " +
                                token,

                            "Accept":
                                "application/json"
                        }
                    }
                );


            if (
                response.status === 401
            ) {

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalToken"
                );

                localStorage.removeItem(
                    "rationPortalUser"
                );

                window.location.href =
                    "login.html";

                return null;

            }


            let data = null;


            try {

                data =
                    await response.json();

            }
            catch (
                jsonError
            ) {

                data = null;

            }


            if (!response.ok) {

                throw new Error(
                    data &&
                    (
                        data.message ||
                        data.error
                    )
                        ? (
                            data.message ||
                            data.error
                        )
                        : "Grievance not found."
                );

            }


            return data;

        }


        async function performSearch(
            number
        ) {

            clearAlert();


            resultArea.classList.remove(
                "show"
            );


            emptyState.style.display =
                "none";


            loadingState.classList.add(
                "show"
            );


            searchButton.disabled =
                true;

            searchButton.textContent =
                "Searching...";


            try {

                const data =
                    await searchGrievance(
                        number
                    );


                if (
                    data === null
                ) {

                    return;

                }


                displayResult(
                    data
                );

            }
            catch (
                error
            ) {

                console.error(
                    "Grievance status error:",
                    error
                );


                showAlert(
                    error.message ||
                    "Unable to retrieve grievance status.",
                    "error"
                );


                emptyState.style.display =
                    "block";

            }
            finally {

                loadingState.classList.remove(
                    "show"
                );

                searchButton.disabled =
                    false;

                searchButton.textContent =
                    "Check Status";

            }

        }


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            function (
                event
            ) {

                event.preventDefault();


                const number =
                    input.value.trim();


                if (!number) {

                    input.focus();

                    showAlert(
                        "Please enter a grievance reference number.",
                        "error"
                    );

                    return;

                }


                performSearch(
                    number
                );

            }
        );


        document.getElementById(
            "printButton"
        ).addEventListener(
            "click",
            function () {

                window.print();

            }
        );


        const params =
            new URLSearchParams(
                window.location.search
            );


        const queryNumber =
            params.get(
                "grievance"
            ) ||
            params.get(
                "number"
            ) ||
            params.get(
                "reference"
            );


        if (queryNumber) {

            input.value =
                queryNumber;

            performSearch(
                queryNumber
            );

        }


        const year =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (year) {

            year.textContent =
                new Date()
                    .getFullYear();

        }

    }
);
</script>

</body>
