    <script>

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {


                /* =================================================
                   GET FORM ELEMENTS
                ================================================== */

                const form =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "loginForm"
                    );


                const emailInput =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "email"
                    );


                const passwordInput =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "password"
                    );


                const loginButton =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "loginButton"
                    );


                const alertBox =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "loginAlert"
                    );


                const togglePassword=[REDACTED]togglePassword"
                    );


                /*
                 * STEP 2:
                 * Terms & Conditions checkbox
                 */

                const termsAccepted =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "termsAccepted"
                    );


                const termsError =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "termsError"
                    );


                const rememberMe =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "rememberMe"
                    );


                /* =================================================
                   API BASE URL
                ================================================== */

                const apiBase =
                    window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                    "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                /* =================================================
                   SHOW ALERT
                ================================================== */

                function showAlert(
                    message,
                    type
                ) {

                    if (!alertBox) {
                        return;
                    }


                    alertBox.textContent =
                        message;


                    alertBox.className =
                        "alert alert-" +
                        type;


                    alertBox.style.display =
                        "block";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   HIDE ALERT
                ================================================== */

                function hideAlert() {

                    if (!alertBox) {
                        return;
                    }


                    alertBox.textContent =
                        "";


                    alertBox.style.display =
                        "none";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   SHOW FIELD ERROR
                ================================================== */

                function showFieldError(
                    elementId,
                    message
                ) {

                    const element =
                        document.getElementById(
                            elementId
                        );


                    if (!element) {
                        return;
                    }


                    element.textContent =
                        message;


                    element.style.display =
                        "block";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   HIDE FIELD ERROR
                ================================================== */

                function hideFieldError(
                    elementId
                ) {

                    const element =
                        document.getElementById(
                            elementId
                        );


                    if (!element) {
                        return;
                    }


                    element.textContent =
                        "";


                    element.style.display =
                        "none";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   SHOW TERMS ERROR

                   This is the important STEP 2 addition.
                ================================================== */

                function showTermsError(
                    message
                ) {

                    if (!termsError) {
                        return;
                    }


                    termsError.textContent =
                        message;


                    termsError.style.display =
                        "block";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   HIDE TERMS ERROR
                ================================================== */

                function hideTermsError() {

                    if (!termsError) {
                        return;
                    }


                    termsError.textContent =
                        "";


                    termsError.style.display =
                        "none";

                }


                /* =================================================
                   EMAIL VALIDATION
                ================================================== */

                function validateEmail(
                    email
                ) {

                    return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
                        .test(email);

                }


                /* =================================================
                   PASSWORD EYE ICON
                ================================================== */

                const eyeIcon =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "eyeIcon"
                    );


                const eyeOffIcon =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "eyeOffIcon"
                    );


                if (togglePassword) {

                    togglePassword.addEventListener(
                        "click",
                        function () {


                            const isPassword=[REDACTED]password";


                            passwordInput.type =
                                isPassword
                                    ? "text"
                                    : "password";


                            if (eyeIcon) {

                                eyeIcon.style.display =
                                    isPassword
                                        ? "none"
                                        : "block";

                            }


                            if (eyeOffIcon) {

                                eyeOffIcon.style.display =
                                    isPassword
                                        ? "block"
                                        : "none";

                            }


                            togglePassword.setAttribute(
                                "aria-label",
                                isPassword
                                    ? "Hide password"
                                    : "Show password"
                            );


                            togglePassword.setAttribute(
                                "title",
                                isPassword
                                    ? "Hide password"
                                    : "Show password"
                            );

                        }
                    );

                }


                /* =================================================
                   EMAIL INPUT EVENT
                ================================================== */

                if (emailInput) {

                    emailInput.addEventListener(
                        "input",
                        function () {

                            hideFieldError(
                                "emailError"
                            );

                            hideAlert();

                        }
                    );

                }


                /* =================================================
                   PASSWORD INPUT EVENT
                ================================================== */

                if (passwordInput) {

                    passwordInput.addEventListener(
                        "input",
                        function () {

                            hideFieldError(
                                "passwordError"
                            );

                            hideAlert();

                        }
                    );

                }


                /* =================================================
                   TERMS CHECKBOX EVENT

                   When the citizen checks the checkbox,
                   the Terms error disappears.
                ================================================== */

                if (termsAccepted) {

                    termsAccepted.addEventListener(
                        "change",
                        function () {

                            hideTermsError();

                            hideAlert();

                        }
                    );

                }


                /* =================================================
                   LOGIN FORM SUBMIT
                ================================================== */

                if (form) {

                    form.addEventListener(
                        "submit",
                        async function (
                            event
                        ) {

                            event.preventDefault();


                            /* =====================================
                               CLEAR OLD ERRORS
                            ====================================== */

                            hideAlert();


                            hideFieldError(
                                "emailError"
                            );


                            hideFieldError(
                                "passwordError"
                            );


                            hideTermsError();


                            /* =====================================
                               GET VALUES
                            ====================================== */

                            const email =
                                emailInput.value
                                    .trim();


                            const password=[REDACTED]emailError",
                                    "Please enter your email address."
                                );


                                valid =
                                    false;

                            }

                            else if (
                                !validateEmail(
                                    email
                                )
                            ) {

                                showFieldError(
                                    "emailError",
                                    "Please enter a valid email address."
                                );


                                valid =
                                    false;

                            }


                            /* =====================================
                               PASSWORD VALIDATION
                            ====================================== */

                            if (!password) {

                                showFieldError(
                                    "passwordError",
                                    "Please enter your password."
                                );


                                valid =
                                    false;

                            }


                            /* =====================================
                               TERMS & CONDITIONS VALIDATION

                               IMPORTANT:
                               Login will NOT continue unless
                               this checkbox is checked.
                            ====================================== */

                            if (
                                !termsAccepted ||
                                !termsAccepted.checked
                            ) {

                                showTermsError(
                                    "Please accept the Terms & Conditions before logging in."
                                );


                                valid =
                                    false;

                            }


                            /* =====================================
                               STOP LOGIN IF ANY VALIDATION FAILED
                            ====================================== */

                            if (!valid) {
                                return;
                            }


                            /* =====================================
                               SAVE ORIGINAL BUTTON TEXT
                            ====================================== */

                            const originalText =
                                loginButton.textContent;


                            loginButton.disabled =
                                true;


                            loginButton.textContent =
                                "Signing in...";


                            /* =====================================
                               LOGIN API REQUEST
                            ====================================== */

                            let timeoutId = null;
                            let countdownId = null;

                            try {

                                /* =====================================
                                   30-SECOND LOGIN TIMEOUT

                                   If the backend does not respond within
                                   30 seconds, cancel the request and show
                                   a clear timeout message.
                                ====================================== */

                                const controller =
                                    new AbortController();

                                let secondsRemaining = 30;

                                loginButton.textContent =
                                    "Signing in... (30s)";

                                countdownId =
                                    window.setInterval(
                                        function () {

                                            secondsRemaining -= 1;

                                            if (secondsRemaining > 0) {

                                                loginButton.textContent =
                                                    "Signing in... (" +
                                                    secondsRemaining +
                                                    "s)";

                                            } else {

                                                loginButton.textContent =
                                                    "Signing in... (0s)";

                                            }

                                        },
                                        1000
                                    );

                                timeoutId =
                                    window.setTimeout(
                                        function () {

                                            controller.abort();

                                        },
                                        30000
                                    );

                                const response =
                                    await fetch(
                                        apiBase +
                                        "/auth/login",
                                        {
                                            method:
                                                "POST",

                                            headers:
                                                {
                                                    "Content-Type":
                                                        "application/json",

                                                    "Accept":
                                                        "application/json"
                                                },

                                            body:
                                                JSON.stringify(
                                                    {
                                                        email:
                                                            email,

                                                        password:[REDACTED]Invalid email or password."
                                                : "Login failed. Please try again.";


                                    throw new Error(
                                        message
                                    );

                                }


                                /* =================================
                                   ACCEPT COMMON RESPONSE FORMATS

                                   {
                                       token: "..."
                                   }

                                   OR

                                   {
                                       accessToken:[REDACTED]
                                   }

                                   OR

                                   {
                                       data: {
                                           token: "..."
                                       }
                                   }

                                   OR

                                   {
                                       data: {
                                           accessToken:[REDACTED]
                                       }
                                   }
                                ================================== */

                                const responseData =
                                    data &&
                                    data.data &&
                                    typeof data.data ===
                                        "object"
                                        ? data.data
                                        : data || {};


                                const token =
                                    responseData.token ||
                                    responseData.accessToken ||
                                    data.token ||
                                    data.accessToken;


                                /* =================================
                                   TOKEN CHECK
                                ================================== */

                                if (!token) {

                                    throw new Error(
                                        "Login succeeded, but the server did not return an authentication token."
                                    );

                                }


                                /* =================================
                                   GET USER INFORMATION
                                ================================== */

                                const user =
                                    responseData.user ||
                                    responseData.profile ||
                                    data.user ||
                                    null;


                                /* =================================
                                   STORE TOKEN
                                ================================== */

                                localStorage.setItem(
                                    "rationPortalToken",
                                    token
                                );


                                /* =================================
                                   STORE USER
                                ================================== */

                                if (user) {

                                    localStorage.setItem(
                                        "rationPortalUser",
                                        JSON.stringify(
                                            user
                                        )
                                    );

                                }


                                /* =================================
                                   REMEMBER ME
                                ================================== */

                                if (
                                    rememberMe &&
                                    rememberMe.checked
                                ) {

                                    localStorage.setItem(
                                        "rationPortalRememberMe",
                                        "true"
                                    );

                                }

                                else {

                                    localStorage.removeItem(
                                        "rationPortalRememberMe"
                                    );

                                }


                                /* =================================
                                   SUCCESS MESSAGE
                                ================================== */

                                showAlert(
                                    "Login successful. Redirecting...",
                                    "success"
                                );


                                loginButton.textContent =
                                    "Login successful";


                                /* =================================
                                   REDIRECT DESTINATION
                                ================================== */

                                const redirect =
                                    sessionStorage.getItem(
                                        "rationPortalRedirect"
                                    );


                                sessionStorage.removeItem(
                                    "rationPortalRedirect"
                                );


                                /* =================================
                                   REDIRECT AFTER LOGIN
                                ================================== */

                                setTimeout(
                                    function () {

                                        if (
                                            redirect &&
                                            redirect !==
                                                "login.html"
                                        ) {

                                            window.location.href =
                                                redirect;

                                        }

                                        else {

                                            window.location.href =
                                                "citizen-dashboard.html";

                                        }

                                    },
                                    500
                                );

                            }


                            /* =====================================
                               LOGIN ERROR
                            ====================================== */

                            catch (
                                error
                            ) {

                                console.error(
                                    "Login error:",
                                    error
                                );


                                if (
                                    error &&
                                    error.name === "AbortError"
                                ) {

                                    showAlert(
                                        "Login request timed out after 30 seconds. The authentication server may be starting or responding slowly. Please try again.",
                                        "danger"
                                    );

                                }

                                else {

                                    showAlert(
                                        error.message ||
                                        "Unable to connect to the authentication service.",
                                        "danger"
                                    );

                                }


                                loginButton.disabled =
                                    false;


                                loginButton.textContent =
                                    originalText;

                            }

                            finally {

                                if (timeoutId) {
                                    window.clearTimeout(timeoutId);
                                }

                                if (countdownId) {
                                    window.clearInterval(countdownId);
                                }

                            }

                        }
                    );

                }


                /* =================================================
                   CURRENT YEAR
                ================================================== */

                const currentYear =
                    document.getElementById(
                        "currentYear"
                    );


                if (currentYear) {

                    currentYear.textContent =
                        new Date()
                            .getFullYear();

                }


                /* =================================================
                   ALREADY LOGGED-IN USER

                   If a token already exists, send the citizen
                   directly to the dashboard.
                ================================================== */

                const existingToken =
                    localStorage.getItem(
                        "rationPortalToken"
                    );


                if (existingToken) {

                    window.location.href =
                        "citizen-dashboard.html";

                }

            }

        );

    </script>

<div class="onorc-step">
<b>4. Authentication & Entitlement</b>
The authorised ePoS process retrieves entitlement information and completes the portability transaction.
</div>

<h3>No New Ration Card</h3>
<p style="line-height:1.6;color:#526a80">ONORC is designed so eligible beneficiaries can use their existing NFSA ration card instead of obtaining a new ration card in the destination State / UT.</p>

<h3>For Migrant Beneficiaries</h3>
<p style="line-height:1.6;color:#526a80">The service is particularly useful for beneficiaries who temporarily move to another State / UT for employment or other reasons.</p>

]
};

var homeState=document.getElementById("homeState");
var destinationState=document.getElementById("destinationState");
var homeDistrict=document.getElementById("homeDistrict");
var destinationDistrict=document.getElementById("destinationDistrict");
var result=document.getElementById("onorcResult");

states.forEach(function(state){
var a=document.createElement("option");
a.value=state;a.textContent=state;homeState.appendChild(a);
var b=document.createElement("option");
b.value=state;b.textContent=state;destinationState.appendChild(b);
});

function loadDistricts(state,select){
select.innerHTML='<option value="">Select District</option>';
var districts=districtsByState[state]||[];
districts.forEach(function(d){
var option=document.createElement("option");
option.value=d;option.textContent=d;select.appendChild(option);
});
if(!districts.length){
var option=document.createElement("option");
option.value="";option.textContent="District selection will be provided through the state integration";
select.appendChild(option);
}
}

homeState.addEventListener("change",function(){loadDistricts(homeState.value,homeDistrict);});
destinationState.addEventListener("change",function(){loadDistricts(destinationState.value,destinationDistrict);});

document.getElementById("onorcForm").addEventListener("submit",function(event){
event.preventDefault();

var card=document.getElementById("rationCardNumber").value.trim();

result.innerHTML=
"<strong>ONORC Portability Check Initiated</strong><br><br>"+
"Ration Card: "+card+"<br>"+
"Home: "+homeState.value+" â€” "+homeDistrict.value+"<br>"+
"Destination: "+destinationState.value+" â€” "+destinationDistrict.value+
"<br><br><strong>Eligible ONORC workflow:</strong> Visit an authorised ePoS-enabled Fair Price Shop at the destination and complete the applicable authentication to access your eligible NFSA entitlement.";

result.classList.add("show");
});

document.getElementById("onorcForm").addEventListener("reset",function(){
setTimeout(function(){
homeDistrict.innerHTML='<option value="">Select Home District</option>';
destinationDistrict.innerHTML='<option value="">Select Destination District</option>';
result.classList.remove("show");
result.innerHTML="";
},0);
});

})();

    <script>
        "use strict";

        const API_BASE =
            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";

        function getToken() {
            return localStorage.getItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );
        }

        function authenticatedFetch(
            url,
            options = {}
        ) {
            const token = getToken();

            const headers = {
                ...(options.headers || {})
            };

            if (token) {
                headers.Authorization =
                    "Bearer " + token;
            }

            headers.Accept =
                "application/json";

            return fetch(url, {
                ...options,
                headers
            });
        }

        function getCurrentUser() {
            try {
                return JSON.parse(
                    localStorage.getItem(
                        "rationPortalUser"
                    ) || "null"
                );
            } catch (error) {
                return null;
            }
        }

        function setText(
            id,
            value,
            fallback = "â€”"
        ) {
            const element =
                document.getElementById(id);

            if (!element) {
                return;
            }

            element.textContent =
                value === null ||
                value === undefined ||
                value === ""
                    ? fallback
                    : value;
        }

        function firstValue(
            object,
            keys,
            fallback = null
        ) {
            if (!object) {
                return fallback;
            }

            for (const key of keys) {
                if (
                    object[key] !== undefined &&
                    object[key] !== null &&
                    object[key] !== ""
                ) {
                    return object[key];
                }
            }

            return fallback;
        }

        function calculateRice(
            data
        ) {
            const adult =
                Number(
                    firstValue(
                        data,
                        [
                            "adultRice",
                            "adultRiceQuota",
                            "adultQuota"
                        ],
                        0
                    )
                ) || 0;

            const child =
                Number(
                    firstValue(
                        data,
                        [
                            "childRice",
                            "childRiceQuota",
                            "childQuota"
                        ],
                        0
                    )
                ) || 0;

            const total =
                Number(
                    firstValue(
                        data,
                        [
                            "totalRice",
                            "totalRiceQuota",
                            "riceQuota"
                        ],
                        adult + child
                    )
                ) || (adult + child);

            setText(
                "adultRice",
                adult
            );

            setText(
                "childRice",
                child
            );

            setText(
                "totalRice",
                total
            );
        }

        function showError(
            message
        ) {
            const loading =
                document.getElementById(
                    "loadingBox"
                );

            const error =
                document.getElementById(
                    "errorBox"
                );

            if (loading) {
                loading.style.display =
                    "none";
            }

            if (error) {
                error.textContent =
                    message;

                error.style.display =
                    "block";
            }
        }

        function showData() {
            const loading =
                document.getElementById(
                    "loadingBox"
                );

            const grid =
                document.getElementById(
                    "detailsGrid"
                );

            const entitlement =
                document.getElementById(
                    "entitlementSection"
                );

            if (loading) {
                loading.style.display =
                    "none";
            }

            if (grid) {
                grid.style.display =
                    "grid";
            }

            if (entitlement) {
                entitlement.style.display =
                    "block";
            }
        }

        function normalizeResponse(
            response
        ) {
            if (!response) {
                return null;
            }

            if (
                response.rationCard
            ) {
                return response.rationCard;
            }

            if (
                response.data
            ) {
                return response.data;
            }

            return response;
        }

        async function loadRationCard() {

            const user =
                getCurrentUser();

            /*
             * The backend is authoritative.
             * We first try the logged-in user's
             * ration-card identifier if one exists.
             */
            const rationCardNumber =
                user
                    ? firstValue(
                        user,
                        [
                            "rationCardNumber",
                            "ration_card_number",
                            "cardNumber",
                            "rationId",
                            "ration_id"
                        ]
                    )
                    : null;

            const memberId =
                user
                    ? firstValue(
                        user,
                        [
                            "memberId",
                            "member_id"
                        ]
                    )
                    : null;

            let endpoint = null;

            if (rationCardNumber) {

                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/ration-cards/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        rationCardNumber
                    );

            } else if (memberId) {

                endpoint =
                    API_BASE +
                    "/family-members/" +
                    encodeURIComponent(
                        memberId
                    );

            } else {

                showError(
                    "Your account does not currently contain a ration card number. Please contact the administrator or complete the ration card application."
                );

                return;
            }

            try {

                const response =
                    await authenticatedFetch(
                        endpoint
                    );

                if (
                    response.status === 401 ||
                    response.status === 403
                ) {
                    if (
                        window.authGuard &&
                        typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                            "function"
                    ) {
                        window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                    }

                    return;
                }

                if (!response.ok) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "Unable to load ration card information."
                    );
                }

                const raw =
                    await response.json();

                const data =
                    normalizeResponse(
                        raw
                    );

                if (!data) {
                    throw new Error(
                        "No ration card information was returned."
                    );
                }

                populateCard(
                    data
                );

            } catch (error) {

                console.error(
                    "Ration card loading error:",
                    error
                );

                /*
                 * If the backend endpoint is not yet
                 * available for the current account,
                 * keep the page usable and clearly
                 * report the real situation.
                 */
                showError(
                    "Ration card details could not be loaded from the server yet. Please make sure your ration card is registered in the system."
                );
            }
        }

        function populateCard(
            data
        ) {

            const cardNumber =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "rationCardNumber",
                        "ration_card_number",
                        "cardNumber",
                        "rationId",
                        "ration_id"
                    ]
                );

            const cardType =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "cardType",
                        "card_type",
                        "type"
                    ]
                );

            const status =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "status",
                        "cardStatus",
                        "card_status"
                    ],
                    "Active"
                );

            const head =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "headOfFamily",
                        "head_of_family",
                        "headOfFamilyName",
                        "name"
                    ]
                );

            const address =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "address",
                        "fullAddress"
                    ]
                );

            const district =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "district"
                    ]
                );

            const state =
                firstValue(
                    data,
                    [
                        "state"
                    ],
                    "Telangana"
                );

            setText(
                "rationCardNumber",
                cardNumber
            );

            setText(
                "detailCardNumber",
                cardNumber
            );

            setText(
                "cardType",
                cardType
            );

            setText(
                "cardStatus",
                status
            );

            setText(
                "headOfFamily",
                head
            );

            setText(
                "address",
                address
            );

            setText(
                "district",
                district
            );

            setText(
                "state",
                state
            );

            setText(
                "recordStatus",
                status
            );

            const pill =
                document.getElementById(
                    "statusPill"
                );

            if (pill) {
                pill.innerHTML =
                    '<span class="active-dot"></span>' +
                    String(status);
            }

            calculateRice(
                data
            );

            showData();
        }

        function updateDate() {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    "currentDate"
                );

            if (!element) {
                return;
            }

            const now =
                new Date();

            element.textContent =
                now.toLocaleDateString(
                    "en-IN",
                    {
                        weekday: "short",
                        day: "2-digit",
                        month: "short",
                        year: "numeric"
                    }
                );
        }

        function logoutCitizen() {

            if (
                window.authGuard &&
                typeof window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect ===
                    "function"
            ) {
                window.authGuard.logoutAndRedirect();
                return;
            }

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalToken"
            );

            localStorage.removeItem(
                "rationPortalUser"
            );

            window.location.href =
                "login.html";
        }

        document.addEventListener(
            "DOMContentLoaded",
            function () {

                updateDate();

                loadRationCard();

            }
        );
    </script>

</body>
</html>

<script>

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "registerForm"
            );

        const nameInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "fullName"
            );

        const emailInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "email"
            );

        const termsAccepted =
            document.getElementById(
                "termsAccepted"
            );

        const termsError =
            document.getElementById(
                "termsError"
            );

        const continueButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "continueButton"
            );

        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "registerAlert"
            );

        const apiBase =
            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


        function showAlert(
            message,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                message;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert alert-" + type;

            alertBox.style.display =
                "block";
        }


        function hideAlert() {

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

            alertBox.style.display =
                "none";
        }


        function showError(
            elementId,
            message
        ) {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    elementId
                );

            element.textContent =
                message;

            element.style.display =
                "block";
        }


        function hideError(
            elementId
        ) {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    elementId
                );

            element.textContent =
                "";

            element.style.display =
                "none";
        }


        function showTermsError(
            message
        ) {

            termsError.textContent =
                message;

            termsError.style.display =
                "block";
        }


        function hideTermsError() {

            termsError.textContent =
                "";

            termsError.style.display =
                "none";
        }


        function validEmail(
            email
        ) {

            return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/
                .test(email);
        }


        nameInput.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                hideError("nameError");
                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        emailInput.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                hideError("emailError");
                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        termsAccepted.addEventListener(
            "change",
            function () {

                hideTermsError();
                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            async function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();

                hideAlert();

                hideError("nameError");

                hideError("emailError");

                hideTermsError();


                const fullName =
                    nameInput.value.trim();


                const email =
                    emailInput.value
                        .trim()
                        .toLowerCase();


                let valid = true;


                if (!fullName) {

                    showError(
                        "nameError",
                        "Please enter your full name."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }


                if (!email) {

                    showError(
                        "emailError",
                        "Please enter your email address."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                } else if (!validEmail(email)) {

                    showError(
                        "emailError",
                        "Please enter a valid email address."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }


                /*
                 * TERMS & CONDITIONS CHECK
                 *
                 * This check happens BEFORE
                 * the backend email request.
                 */

                if (!termsAccepted.checked) {

                    showTermsError(
                        "Please accept the Terms & Conditions before continuing."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }


                if (!valid) {

                    return;
                }


                const originalText =
                    continueButton.textContent;


                continueButton.disabled =
                    true;


                continueButton.textContent =
                    "Checking email...";


                try {

                    const response =
                        await fetch(
                            apiBase +
                            "/auth/check-email",
                            {
                                method: "POST",

                                headers: {
                                    "Content-Type":
                                        "application/json",

                                    "Accept":
                                        "application/json"
                                },

                                body:
                                    JSON.stringify({
                                        email: email
                                    })
                            }
                        );


                    let data = null;


                    try {

                        data =
                            await response.json();

                    } catch (error) {

                        data = null;

                    }


                    if (!response.ok) {

                        throw new Error(
                            data &&
                            data.message
                                ? data.message
                                : "Unable to check this email address."
                        );
                    }


                    if (
                        !data ||
                        data.available !== true
                    ) {

                        showError(
                            "emailError",
                            data &&
                            data.message
                                ? data.message
                                : "This email address is already registered."
                        );


                        continueButton.disabled =
                            false;


                        continueButton.textContent =
                            originalText;


                        return;
                    }


                    sessionStorage.setItem(
                        "rationRegistrationName",
                        fullName
                    );


                    sessionStorage.setItem(
                        "rationRegistrationEmail",
                        email
                    );


                    window.location.href =
                        "register-password.html";

                }
                catch (error) {

                    console.error(
                        "Registration email check error:",
                        error
                    );


                    showAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Unable to connect to the registration service.",
                        "danger"
                    );


                    continueButton.disabled =
                        false;


                    continueButton.textContent =
                        originalText;
                }

            }
        );


        const currentYear =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );


        if (currentYear) {

            currentYear.textContent =
                new Date().getFullYear();

        }

    }
);

</script>

</body>
</html>

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const fullName =
            sessionStorage.getItem(
                "rationRegistrationName"
            );

        const email =
            sessionStorage.getItem(
                "rationRegistrationEmail"
            );

        if (!fullName || !email) {

            window.location.href =
                "register.html";

            return;
        }

        const emailDisplay =
            document.getElementById(
                "registrationEmail"
            );

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "passwordForm"
            );

        const passwordInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "password"
            );

        const confirmPasswordInput =
            document.getElementById(
                "confirmPassword"
            );

        const declaration =
            document.getElementById(
                "declaration"
            );

        const registerButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "registerButton"
            );

        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "registerAlert"
            );

        const togglePassword=[REDACTED]togglePassword"
            );

        const toggleConfirmPassword=[REDACTED]toggleConfirmPassword"
            );

        const apiBase =
            window.RATION_API_BASE ||
            "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";

        emailDisplay.textContent =
            email;

        function showAlert(
            message,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                message;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert alert-" + type;

            alertBox.style.display =
                "block";
        }

        function hideAlert() {

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

            alertBox.style.display =
                "none";
        }

        function showError(
            elementId,
            message
        ) {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    elementId
                );

            element.textContent =
                message;

            element.style.display =
                "block";
        }

        function hideError(
            elementId
        ) {

            const element =
                document.getElementById(
                    elementId
                );

            element.textContent =
                "";

            element.style.display =
                "none";
        }

        function setupPasswordToggle(
            button,
            input,
            eyeIcon,
            eyeOffIcon
        ) {

            button.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    const isPassword=[REDACTED]password";

                    input.type =
                        isPassword
                            ? "text"
                            : "password";

                    if (eyeIcon) {

                        eyeIcon.style.display =
                            isPassword
                                ? "none"
                                : "block";
                    }

                    if (eyeOffIcon) {

                        eyeOffIcon.style.display =
                            isPassword
                                ? "block"
                                : "none";
                    }

                    button.setAttribute(
                        "aria-label",
                        isPassword
                            ? "Hide password"
                            : "Show password"
                    );

                    button.setAttribute(
                        "title",
                        isPassword
                            ? "Hide password"
                            : "Show password"
                    );

                }
            );
        }

        setupPasswordToggle(
            togglePassword,
            passwordInput,
            document.getElementById(
                "eyeIcon"
            ),
            document.getElementById(
                "eyeOffIcon"
            )
        );

        setupPasswordToggle(
            toggleConfirmPassword,
            confirmPasswordInput,
            null,
            null
        );

        passwordInput.addEventListener(

            async function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();

                hideAlert();

                hideError("passwordError");
                hideError("confirmPasswordError");
                hideError("declarationError");

                const password=[REDACTED]passwordError",
                        "Please enter a password."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                } else if (
                    password.length < 8
                ) {

                    showError(
                        "passwordError",
                        "Password must contain at least 8 characters."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }

                if (!confirmPassword) {

                    showError(
                        "confirmPasswordError",
                        "Please confirm your password."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                } else if (
                    password !== confirmPassword
                ) {

                    showError(
                        "confirmPasswordError",
                        "Passwords do not match."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }

                if (!declaration.checked) {

                    showError(
                        "declarationError",
                        "Please accept the citizen declaration."
                    );

                    valid = false;
                }

                if (!valid) {
                    return;
                }

                const originalText =
                    registerButton.textContent;

                registerButton.disabled =
                    true;

                registerButton.textContent =
                    "Creating account...";

                try {

                    const response =
                        await fetch(
                            apiBase +
                            "/auth/register",
                            {
                                method: "POST",

                                headers: {
                                    "Content-Type":
                                        "application/json",

                                    "Accept":
                                        "application/json"
                                },

                                body:
                                    JSON.stringify({
                                        fullName:
                                            fullName,

                                        email:
                                            email,

                                        password:[REDACTED]Registration failed. Please try again."
                        );
                    }

                    sessionStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationRegistrationName"
                    );

                    sessionStorage.removeItem(
                        "rationRegistrationEmail"
                    );

                    showAlert(
                        "Account created successfully. Redirecting to login...",
                        "success"
                    );

                    registerButton.textContent =
                        "Account created";

                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            window.location.href =
                                "login.html";

                        },
                        1000
                    );

                }
                catch (error) {

                    console.error(
                        "Registration error:",
                        error
                    );

                    showAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Unable to connect to the registration service.",
                        "danger"
                    );

                    registerButton.disabled =
                        false;

                    registerButton.textContent =
                        originalText;
                }

            }
        );

        const currentYear =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );

        if (currentYear) {

            currentYear.textContent =
                new Date().getFullYear();

        }

    }
);

document.addEventListener(
    "DOMContentLoaded",
    function () {

        const form =
            document.getElementById(
                "resetPasswordForm"
            );


        const newPassword=[REDACTED]newPassword"
            );


        const confirmPassword=[REDACTED]confirmPassword"
            );


        const passwordError =
            document.getElementById(
                "passwordError"
            );


        const confirmPasswordError =
            document.getElementById(
                "confirmPasswordError"
            );


        const resetButton =
            document.getElementById(
                "resetButton"
            );


        const alertBox =
            document.getElementById(
                "resetAlert"
            );


        const newPasswordToggle =
            document.getElementById(
                "newPasswordToggle"
            );


        const confirmPasswordToggle =
            document.getElementById(
                "confirmPasswordToggle"
            );


        function showError(
            element,
            message
        ) {

            element.textContent =
                message;

            element.style.display =
                "block";

        }


        function hideError(
            element
        ) {

            element.textContent =
                "";

            element.style.display =
                "none";

        }


        function showAlert(
            message,
            type
        ) {

            alertBox.textContent =
                message;

            alertBox.className =
                "alert alert-" + type;

            alertBox.style.display =
                "block";

        }


        function hideAlert() {

            alertBox.textContent =
                "";

            alertBox.style.display =
                "none";

        }


        /*
         * PASSWORD SHOW / HIDE
         *
         * IMPORTANT:
         * We use innerHTML here instead of textContent
         * so the eye symbol is rendered correctly.
         */

        function setupPasswordToggle(
            input,
            button
        ) {

            button.addEventListener(
                "click",
                function () {

                    if (
                        input.type === "password"
                    ) {

                        input.type = "text";

                        button.innerHTML = "ðŸ™ˆ";

                        button.setAttribute(
                            "aria-label",
                            "Hide password"
                        );

                        button.setAttribute(
                            "title",
                            "Hide password"
                        );

                    }
                    else {

                        input.type = "password";

                        button.innerHTML = "ðŸ‘ï¸";

                        button.setAttribute(
                            "aria-label",
                            "Show password"
                        );

                        button.setAttribute(
                            "title",
                            "Show password"
                        );

                    }

                }
            );

        }


        setupPasswordToggle(
            newPassword,
            newPasswordToggle
        );


        setupPasswordToggle(
            confirmPassword,
            confirmPasswordToggle
        );


        function removeSpaces(
            input
        ) {

            input.value =
                input.value.replace(
                    /\s/g,
                    ""
                );

        }


        newPassword.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                removeSpaces(
                    newPassword
                );

                hideError(
                    passwordError
                );

                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        confirmPassword.addEventListener(
            "input",
            function () {

                removeSpaces(
                    confirmPassword
                );

                hideError(
                    confirmPasswordError
                );

                hideAlert();

            }
        );


        form.addEventListener(
            "submit",
            async function (event) {

                event.preventDefault();


                hideError(
                    passwordError
                );

                hideError(
                    confirmPasswordError
                );

                hideAlert();


                removeSpaces(
                    newPassword
                );

                removeSpaces(
                    confirmPassword
                );


                const password=[REDACTED]Please enter a new password."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }
                else if (
                    password.length < 8
                ) {

                    showError(
                        passwordError,
                        "Password must contain at least 8 characters."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (!confirmation) {

                    showError(
                        confirmPasswordError,
                        "Please confirm your new password."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }
                else if (
                    password !== confirmation
                ) {

                    showError(
                        confirmPasswordError,
                        "Passwords do not match."
                    );

                    valid = false;

                }


                if (!valid) {

                    return;

                }


                const params =
                    new URLSearchParams(
                        window.location.search
                    );


                const token =
                    params.get(
                        "token"
                    );


                if (!token) {

                    showAlert(
                        "This password reset link is invalid or incomplete.",
                        "danger"
                    );

                    return;

                }


                const originalText =
                    resetButton.textContent;


                resetButton.disabled =
                    true;


                resetButton.textContent =
                    "Resetting...";


                const apiBase =
                    window.RATION_API_BASE ||
                    "https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";


                try {

                    const response =
                        await fetch(
                            apiBase +
                            "/auth/reset-password",
                            {
                                method: "POST",

                                headers: {
                                    "Content-Type":
                                        "application/json",

                                    "Accept":
                                        "application/json"
                                },

                                body:
                                     JSON.stringify({
                                    token: token,
                                    newPassword:[REDACTED]Unable to reset the password."
                        );

                    }


                    showAlert(
                        data &&
                        data.message
                            ? data.message
                            : "Password reset successfully. You can now log in.",
                        "success"
                    );


                    newPassword.value =
                        "";

                    confirmPassword.value =
                        "";


                    setTimeout(
                        function () {

                            window.location.href =
                                "login.html";

                        },
                        2000
                    );

                }
                catch (
                    error
                ) {

                    console.error(
                        "Reset password error:",
                        error
                    );


                    showAlert(
                        error.message ||
                        "Unable to connect to the password reset service.",
                        "danger"
                    );

                }
                finally {

                    resetButton.disabled =
                        false;

                    resetButton.textContent =
                        originalText;

                }

            }
        );


        const currentYear =
            document.getElementById(
                "currentYear"
            );


        if (currentYear) {

                new Date().getFullYear();

        }

const initial=params.get("q");

form.addEventListener("submit",async function(event){
event.preventDefault();
const id=input.value.trim();
if(!id){result.textContent="Please enter a ration card ID.";return;}
result.textContent="Searching...";
try{
const base=window.RATION_API_BASE||"https://ration-portal-backend.onrender.com/api";
const request=(window.rationAuth&&window.rationAuth.authenticatedFetch)?window.rationAuth.authenticatedFetch:fetch;
const response=await request(base+"/ration-cards/"+encodeURIComponent(id),{method:"GET",headers:{"Accept":"application/json"}});
const text=await response.text();
let data=null;
try{data=JSON.parse(text);}catch(_){}
if(!response.ok){result.textContent=(data&&data.message)||"Ration card could not be found or access was denied.";return;}
result.textContent=JSON.stringify(data,null,2);
}catch(error){result.textContent="Unable to connect to the backend service. Please try again.";}}
);
})();
